    'SE-Q': lambda b: (_dot(b, 0, 0.18, 0.09), _line(b, [(0, 0.08), (0, -0.12)], 0.04), _line(b, [(-0.18, 0.0), (0.18, 0.0)]), _line(b, [(-0.14, -0.3), (0, -0.12), (0.14, -0.3)])),
    'SE-R': lambda b: (_line(b, [(-0.22, -0.22), (0.12, 0.12)], 0.045), _curve(b, _arc(0.18, 0.18, 0.1, -PI * 0.9, PI * 0.35))),
    'SE-S': lambda b: (_curve(b, _arc(0, 0, 0.26, 0, 2 * PI)), _line(b, [(0, 0.34), (0, -0.34)], 0.02), _line(b, [(-0.34, 0), (0.34, 0)], 0.02), _dot(b, 0, 0, 0.05)),
    'SE-T': lambda b: (_line(b, [(0, -0.2), (-0.3, -0.12), (-0.3, 0.22), (0, 0.14), (0.3, 0.22), (0.3, -0.12), (0, -0.2), (0, 0.14)])),
    'SE-U': lambda b: (_curve(b, _arc(0, 0.02, 0.27, 0, 2 * PI)), _line(b, [(-0.14, 0.02), (-0.03, -0.1), (0.16, 0.14)], 0.035), _block(b, 0, -0.33, 0.36, 0.06)),
}

# Attribute each SE card improves (Appendix A) -> plaque outline.
OUTLINE = {'SA': 6, 'COM': 40, 'MOB': 8}


def _outline(effect):
    """Plaque outline as (u, v) points."""
    if effect == 'PRO':
        return [(-0.45, 0.42), (0.45, 0.42), (0.45, -0.05), (0.0, -0.5), (-0.45, -0.05)]
    if effect == 'CAP':
        return [(-0.44, -0.44), (0.44, -0.44), (0.44, 0.44), (-0.44, 0.44)]
    n = OUTLINE[effect]
    r = 0.5 if n != 8 else 0.48
    off = PI / 2 if n == 6 else PI / 8 if n == 8 else 0
    return [(math.cos(off + 2 * PI * k / n) * r, math.sin(off + 2 * PI * k / n) * r) for k in range(n)]


def token(mats, card_id, effect, yaw_deg):
    """Build card_id's plaque on a small stand, turned to face a camera at yaw_deg."""
    b = Builder(card_id, mats, (0, 0, 0.62), (0, 0, math.radians(yaw_deg)))
    pts = _outline(effect)
    # Wedge extrudes an (x, z) profile along Y: the plaque is 0.1 thick, centred on y = 0.
    b.wedge('plaque', pts, 0.1, (0, 0, 0), 'paint_dark', bevel=0.03, segments=3)
    inner = [(u * 0.86, v * 0.86) for u, v in pts]
    b.tube('border', [_p(u, v, 0.005) for u, v in inner + inner[:1]], 0.012, 'steel', smooth=False)
    for item in ICONS[card_id](b) or ():
        pass
    b.box('stand', (0.5, 0.36, 0.06), (0, 0.06, -0.55), 'gunmetal', bevel=0.02)
    b.box('stand-back', (0.08, 0.06, 0.4), (0, 0.12, -0.35), 'gunmetal', rot=(-0.35, 0, 0), bevel=0.01)
    return b


def practice(mats):
    """TRAIN-CAP: a training crate module with hazard bands, the practice lot's stand-in part."""
    b = Builder('TRAIN-CAP', mats)
    L, W, H = 1.6, 1.2, 0.9
    b.box('crate', (L, W, H), (0, 0, H / 2), 'paint', bevel=0.04, segments=3)
    for x in (-L / 2 + 0.12, L / 2 - 0.12):
        for k in range(4):
            b.box('band', (0.12, W + 0.02, 0.1), (x, 0, 0.15 + k * 0.2), 'yellow' if k % 2 == 0 else 'black', bevel=0.005)
    for side in (-1, 1):
        b.box('handle', (0.3, 0.04, 0.05), (0, side * (W / 2 + 0.03), H * 0.7), 'steel', bevel=0.01)
    b.box('lid-seam', (L + 0.01, W + 0.01, 0.02), (0, 0, H - 0.12), 'black', bevel=0.004)
    return b

"""Render settings, studio lighting, cameras and layer visibility (MPES §10, §11).

Everything is procedural: no image files, HDRIs or downloads, so renders depend only on these
scripts and the pinned Blender version.
"""
import math

import bpy
from mathutils import Vector

SEED = 20261010


def reset():
    bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
    scene = bpy.context.scene
    scene.unit_settings.system = 'METRIC'
    return scene


def use_gpu():
    prefs = bpy.context.preferences.addons['cycles'].preferences
    for kind in ('OPTIX', 'CUDA'):
        try:
            prefs.compute_device_type = kind
            prefs.get_devices()
        except TypeError:
            continue
        devices = [d for d in prefs.devices if d.type == kind]
        if devices:
            for d in prefs.devices:
                d.use = d.type == kind
            return kind
    return 'CPU'


def configure(width, height, samples):
    scene = bpy.context.scene
    scene.render.engine = 'CYCLES'
    device = use_gpu()
    scene.cycles.device = 'GPU' if device != 'CPU' else 'CPU'
    scene.cycles.samples = samples
    scene.cycles.seed = SEED
    scene.cycles.use_adaptive_sampling = False  # same samples everywhere: stable, repeatable noise
    scene.cycles.use_denoising = True
    scene.cycles.denoiser = 'OPENIMAGEDENOISE'
    scene.cycles.max_bounces = 8
    scene.cycles.transparent_max_bounces = 8
    scene.render.resolution_x, scene.render.resolution_y = width, height
    scene.render.resolution_percentage = 100
    scene.render.film_transparent = True
    settings = scene.render.image_settings
    settings.file_format = 'PNG'
    settings.color_mode = 'RGBA'
    settings.color_depth = '16'
    settings.compression = 15
    scene.view_settings.view_transform = 'AgX'
    for look in ('AgX - Medium High Contrast', 'Medium High Contrast'):
        try:
            scene.view_settings.look = look
            break
        except TypeError:
            continue
    scene.view_settings.exposure = -0.25
    return device


def world():
    """Dim neutral studio environment; reflections come from hidden light cards."""
    w = bpy.data.worlds.new('studio')
    w.use_nodes = True
    bg = w.node_tree.nodes['Background']
    bg.inputs['Color'].default_value = (0.045, 0.05, 0.055, 1)
    bg.inputs['Strength'].default_value = 1.0
    bpy.context.scene.world = w


def _area(name, location, target, size, energy, color=(1, 1, 1), shape='RECTANGLE', size_y=None):
    data = bpy.data.lights.new(name, 'AREA')
    data.shape = shape
    data.size = size
    if size_y is not None:
        data.size_y = size_y
    data.energy = energy
    data.color = color
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, data)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.location = location
    direction = Vector(target) - Vector(location)
    obj.rotation_euler = direction.to_track_quat('-Z', 'Y').to_euler()
    obj['sea_layer'] = 'rig'
    return obj


def _card(name, location, target, size, strength):
    """Emissive panel seen only in reflections: gives paint and glass studio highlights."""
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new(name)
    half = size / 2
    mesh.from_pydata([(-half[0], -half[1], 0), (half[0], -half[1], 0), (half[0], half[1], 0), (-half[0], half[1], 0)], [], [(0, 1, 2, 3)])
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, mesh)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.location = location
    obj.rotation_euler = (Vector(target) - Vector(location)).to_track_quat('Z', 'Y').to_euler()
    mat = bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    mat.use_nodes = True
    nodes = mat.node_tree.nodes
    nodes.clear()
    out = nodes.new('ShaderNodeOutputMaterial')
    em = nodes.new('ShaderNodeEmission')
    em.inputs['Strength'].default_value = strength
    mat.node_tree.links.new(em.outputs[0], out.inputs['Surface'])
    mesh.materials.append(mat)
    obj.visible_camera = False
    obj.visible_shadow = False
    obj.visible_diffuse = False
    obj['sea_layer'] = 'rig'
    return obj


def studio(center=(0, 0, 1.2), scale=1.0):
    """Key, fill and rim area lights plus reflection cards, scaled to the subject."""
    c = Vector(center)
    s = scale
    _area('key', c + Vector((-6, -7, 7)) * s, c, 5 * s, 1150 * s * s, (1.0, 0.96, 0.9))
    _area('fill', c + Vector((8, -4, 3)) * s, c, 7 * s, 260 * s * s, (0.85, 0.9, 1.0))
    _area('rim', c + Vector((2, 9, 5)) * s, c, 6 * s, 900 * s * s, (0.9, 0.95, 1.0))
    _area('top', c + Vector((0, 0, 10)) * s, c, 8 * s, 320 * s * s)
    _card('strip-left', c + Vector((-9, -3, 4)) * s, c, Vector((1.2, 8)) * s, 6)
    _card('strip-right', c + Vector((9, -2, 5)) * s, c, Vector((1.2, 8)) * s, 4)
    _card('strip-top', c + Vector((0, -2, 11)) * s, c, Vector((10, 2)) * s, 3)


def ground():
    """Large shadow catcher: shadows and contact occlusion only, transparent elsewhere."""
    mesh = bpy.data.meshes.new('ground')
    r = 60
    mesh.from_pydata([(-r, -r, 0), (r, -r, 0), (r, r, 0), (-r, r, 0)], [], [(0, 1, 2, 3)])
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('ground', mesh)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    obj.is_shadow_catcher = True
    obj['sea_layer'] = 'rig'
    return obj


def camera(lens=50):
    data = bpy.data.cameras.new('camera')
    data.lens = lens
    data.sensor_width = 36
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new('camera', data)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    bpy.context.scene.camera = obj
    return obj


def aim(cam, target, yaw_deg, pitch_deg, distance):
    """Place the camera on a sphere around target. Yaw 0 looks at the vehicle's left side (−Y)."""
    yaw, pitch = math.radians(yaw_deg), math.radians(pitch_deg)
    t = Vector(target)
    cam.location = t + Vector((math.sin(yaw) * math.cos(pitch), -math.cos(yaw) * math.cos(pitch), math.sin(pitch))) * distance
    cam.rotation_euler = (t - cam.location).to_track_quat('-Z', 'Y').to_euler()


def fit(cam, target, yaw_deg, pitch_deg, objects, margin=1.08):
    """Aim from (yaw, pitch) and move the camera along its view axis until every bounding-box corner fits."""
    aim(cam, target, yaw_deg, pitch_deg, 50.0)
    depsgraph = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    coords = []
    for obj in objects:
        if obj.type not in {'MESH', 'CURVE'}:
            continue
        ev = obj.evaluated_get(depsgraph)
        coords.extend(obj.matrix_world @ Vector(c) for c in ev.bound_box)
    flat = [v for c in coords for v in c]
    location, _ = cam.camera_fit_coords(depsgraph, flat)
    forward = (cam.matrix_world.to_quaternion() @ Vector((0, 0, -1))).normalized()
    # Back off along the view axis so the subject fills 1/margin of the frame.
    centre = sum(coords, Vector()) / len(coords)
    distance = (Vector(location) - centre).dot(-forward)
    cam.location = Vector(location) - forward * distance * (margin - 1)


def bounds(objects):
    lo = Vector((1e9, 1e9, 1e9))
    hi = Vector((-1e9, -1e9, -1e9))
    depsgraph = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    for obj in objects:
        if obj.type not in {'MESH', 'CURVE'}:
            continue
        ev = obj.evaluated_get(depsgraph)
        for corner in ev.bound_box:
            p = obj.matrix_world @ Vector(corner)
            lo = Vector(map(min, lo, p))
            hi = Vector(map(max, hi, p))
    return lo, hi


def layer_objects(layer):
    return [o for o in bpy.context.scene.objects if o.get('sea_layer') == layer]


def show_layers(visible, catchers=()):
    """Render only `visible` layers; `catchers` layers become shadow catchers (hold out + receive shadows)."""
    for obj in bpy.context.scene.objects:
        layer = obj.get('sea_layer')
        if layer in (None, 'rig'):
            continue
        obj.hide_render = layer not in visible and layer not in catchers
        obj.is_shadow_catcher = layer in catchers


def render(path):
    bpy.context.scene.render.filepath = path
    bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)

"""The fictional 8x8 armoured vehicle family (owner concepts, 2026-10-10): one hull, six mission variants.

A narrow lower hull between the wheels, wide sponsons over them, an inward-sloped upper hull, a long upper
glacis and a raked lower nose. Bolted appliqué plates cover the sides and glacis. Variants change only what
a mission needs in its base form: the troop carrier's lowered ramp and lit compartment, armoured windscreens
on the command and mine-clearing vehicles, and the recovery crane.

def _panel(b, name, origin, u, v, size, mat='paint', cols=1, rows=1):
    """Thin bevelled service plates with sparse perimeter fasteners, flush to a mount face."""

    o = Vector(origin)
    rot = basis.to_euler()
    bolts = Batch(b, name + '-fasteners', 'gunmetal', basis, o)
    for i in range(cols):
        for j in range(rows):
            w, h = size[0] / cols - .018, size[1] / rows - .018
            x, y = (i + .5) * size[0] / cols, (j + .5) * size[1] / rows
            b.box(name, (w, h, .018), o + basis @ Vector((x, y, .009)), mat, rot=rot, bevel=.006, segments=2)
            for dx in (-w / 2 + .055, w / 2 - .055):
                for dy in (-h / 2 + .05, h / 2 - .05):
                    bolts.cyl(.022, .012, (x + dx, y + dy, .021), verts=6)
            if w > .65:
                for dy in (-h / 2 + .05, h / 2 - .05):

    mesh = Batch(b, name+'-mesh', 'gunmetal', basis, o)

    for k in range(int((h-.08)/.055)+1):

    b.box('shovel-socket',(.16,.035,.05),(-.01,s*1.30,2.01),'steel',bevel=.009)
    b.wedge('shovel-blade',[(-.13,-.075),(.07,-.075),(.13,-.025),(.13,.05),(-.13,.05)],.035,(.13,s*1.3,2.01),'gunmetal',bevel=.012)
    b.box('pick-head',(.075,.055,.23),(-.08,s*1.29,2.15),'gunmetal',rot=(0,.27,0),bevel=.012)
    # Short folding ladder uses the centre axle gap; upper attachments remain inside the side slot plane.
    lx=.075
    for dx in (-.12,.12):
        b.tube('ladder-rail',[(lx+dx,s*1.36,.72),(lx+dx,s*1.385,1.30)],.017,'gunmetal',smooth=False)
    for z in (.76,.96,1.16):
        b.box('ladder-rung',(.28,.085,.025),(lx,s*1.385,z),'steel',bevel=.005)
    b.tube('boarding-handle',[(1.33,s*1.25,2.01),(1.33,s*1.34,2.06),(1.66,s*1.34,2.06),(1.66,s*1.25,2.01)],.015,'paint_dark',smooth=False)
    if s>0:
        _grille(b,'exhaust',(.83,1.242,2.06),(-1,0,0),(0,-.26,.44),(.66,.32))



def _cheeks(b):
    """Faceted cheek plates follow the immutable front stations; no expanded hull envelope."""
    for side in (-1,1):
        points=[(2.075,side*1.374,1.39),(2.925,side*1.316,1.385),
                (2.925,side*1.316,1.601),(2.075,side*1.374,1.851)]
        upper=[(2.075,side*1.373,1.865),(2.925,side*1.314,1.617),
               (2.925,side*1.070,1.755),(2.075,side*1.119,2.296)]
        for ring in (points,upper):
            bm=bmesh.new()
            outer=[bm.verts.new(p) for p in ring]
            inner=[bm.verts.new(Vector(p)-Vector((0,side*.014,0))) for p in ring]
            bm.faces.new(outer); bm.faces.new(inner[::-1])
            for k in range(4):
                bm.faces.new((outer[k],outer[(k+1)%4],inner[(k+1)%4],inner[k]))
            bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm,faces=list(bm.faces))
            b._mesh('front-cheek',bm,'paint',(0,0,0),(0,0,0),.004,2,smooth=False)
        bolts=Batch(b,'cheek-bolts','gunmetal')
        for x,y,z in ((2.15,1.379,1.45),(2.82,1.333,1.45),(2.81,1.332,1.63),
                      (2.13,1.361,1.89),(2.15,1.166,2.19),(2.78,1.123,1.80)):
            bolts.cyl(.022,.018,(x,side*y,z),(PI/2,0,0),verts=6)
        bolts.done()


def _front(b, mission):
    """Glacis service panels, framed vision blocks, guarded lamps and forged towing eyes."""
    bottom=Vector((GLACIS_X,-.91,GLACIS_Z))
    up=Vector((ROOF_FRONT-GLACIS_X,0,TOP-GLACIS_Z))
    normal=Vector((up.z,0,-up.x)).normalized()
    rake=math.atan2(up.z,-up.x)
    glazed=mission in ('COMMAND','MINE')
    _panel(b,'glacis',bottom+up.normalized()*.045,(0,1,0),up,(1.82,up.length*(.34 if glazed else .87)),cols=2)
    for y in (-.47,.47):
        if glazed:
            c=Vector((GLACIS_X,y,GLACIS_Z))+up*.68
            b.box('windscreen-gasket',(.50,.85,.055),c+normal*.023,'rubber',rot=(0,rake,0),bevel=.025)
            b.box('windscreen-glass',(.44,.75,.020),c+normal*.057,'glass',rot=(0,rake,0),bevel=.015)
            # Armour rails frame the glass instead of covering it with a single slab.
            for dy in (-.412,.412):
                b.box('window-rail',(.51,.045,.045),c+Vector((0,dy,0))+normal*.052,'paint',rot=(0,rake,0),bevel=.007)
            for t in (-.244,.244):
                pos=c+up.normalized()*t+normal*.052
                b.box('window-rail',(.045,.85,.045),pos,'paint',rot=(0,rake,0),bevel=.007)
            a=c-up.normalized()*.19+Vector((0,-.27,0))+normal*.08
            z=c+up.normalized()*.04+Vector((0,.12,0))+normal*.08
            b.tube('wiper-arm',[a,z],.012,'black',smooth=False)
            b.tube('wiper-blade',[z+Vector((0,-.20,0)),z+Vector((0,.16,0))],.014,'rubber',smooth=False)
        else:
            c=Vector((2.25,y,TOP-(2.25-ROOF_FRONT)*(TOP-GLACIS_Z)/(GLACIS_X-ROOF_FRONT)))
            b.box('vision-hood',(.24,.42,.12),c+normal*.074,'paint_dark',rot=(0,rake,0),bevel=.024)
            b.box('vision-glass',(.027,.32,.063),c+normal*.083+Vector((.119,0,-.061)),'glass',rot=(0,rake,0),bevel=.008)
        b.tube('glacis-grab',[(2.72,y-.13,1.91),(2.72,y-.13,1.99),(2.72,y+.13,1.99),(2.72,y+.13,1.91)],.018,'paint_dark',smooth=False)
    nose_up=Vector((GLACIS_X-FRONT,0,GLACIS_Z-1.48))
    _panel(b,'nose-deck',(FRONT-.025,-.82,1.495),(0,1,0),nose_up,(1.64,.51),cols=2)
    for y in (-.70,.70):
        b.cyl('nose-hinge',.024,.20,(3.29,y,1.602),'gunmetal',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=12,bevel=.003)
    _panel(b,'nose', (FRONT+.001,-.73,1.08),(0,1,0),(0,0,1),(1.46,.32),cols=3)
    for y in (-.62,.62):
        b.box('tow-clevis',(.13,.19,.14),(FRONT+.015,y,1.19),'paint_dark',bevel=.018)
        b.cyl('tow-pin',.044,.24,(FRONT+.09,y,1.18),'gunmetal',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=16,bevel=.004)
        pts=[(FRONT+.12,y+.095*math.sin(a),1.065+.13*math.cos(a)) for a in [2*PI*k/16 for k in range(17)]]
        b.tube('tow-shackle',pts,.027,'steel',smooth=False)
    for side in (-1,1):
        at=Vector((GLACIS_X+.03,side*1.095,1.64))
        b.box('headlight-housing',(.25,.38,.24),at,'paint_dark',bevel=.025)
        b.box('headlight-inset',(.018,.335,.19),at+Vector((.13,0,0)),'black',bevel=.013)
        for dy,r,mat in ((-side*.075,.063,'lamp'),(side*.098,.041,'amber')):
            b.cyl('lamp-bezel',r+.012,.036,at+Vector((.143,dy,0)),'gunmetal',rot=(0,PI/2,0),verts=24,bevel=.003)
            b.cyl('lamp-lens',r,.014,at+Vector((.166,dy,0)),mat,rot=(0,PI/2,0),verts=24,bevel=.003)
        cage=Batch(b,'headlight-cage','paint_dark')
        for z in (-.12,-.04,.04,.12):
            cage.box((.016,.405,.016),at+Vector((.203,0,z)))
        for yy in (-.20,-.066,.066,.20):
            cage.box((.016,.016,.25),at+Vector((.203,yy,0)))
        for yy in (-.20,.20):
            cage.box((.22,.018,.018),at+Vector((.1,yy,.12)))
        cage.done(bevel=.004)
        arm=Vector((2.19,side*1.21,2.065))
        b.box('mirror-foot',(.14,.07,.10),arm,'paint_dark',bevel=.009)
        b.tube('mirror-arm',[arm,arm+Vector((.08,side*.23,.07)),arm+Vector((.08,side*.25,.19))],.018,'gunmetal',smooth=False)
        c=arm+Vector((.08,side*.25,.27))
        b.box('mirror-shell',(.065,.18,.29),c,'rubber',bevel=.022)
        b.box('mirror-face',(.012,.148,.252),c+Vector((-.037,0,0)),'glass',bevel=.014)


def _mast_x(mission):
    """The sensor mast stands back from the roof front, behind the auxiliary gun's muzzle from the hero's side, so the
    pole never reads as the barrel carried on (art/blender/sightline.py); the recovery vehicle's turret sits further
    back, so its mast keeps the forward spot."""
    return ROOF_FRONT - (0.7 if mission == 'RECOVERY' else 1.35)


def _aux_x(mission):
    """The auxiliary weapon mount's x, ahead of the main weapon ring; it stands outboard of the roof armour bay."""
    return ROOF_FRONT-(.77 if mission=='RECOVERY' else .95)


def _roof(b, mission):
    """Low-profile deck service hatches and vents; all mission equipment remains separate."""
    # Inboard of the sensor-mast lane (y .85 to the roof edge).
    _grille(b,'engine-deck',(1.40,.545,TOP+.002),(1,0,0),(0,1,0),(.90,.55))
    _panel(b,'engine-access',(.22,.27,TOP),(1,0,0),(0,1,0),(.63,.70))
    # Deck centre and edges have only flush seams; no smoke tubes or equipment racks.
    seams=Batch(b,'deck-seams','paint_dark')
    for x in (-2.15,-1.0,.25):
        seams.box((.008,1.99,.003),(x,0,TOP+.001))
    seams.done()
    if mission not in ('COMMAND','MINE'):
        # Under the auxiliary weapon mount, whose station stands on this hatch ring (owner FIX 1 sweep).
        hx,hy=_aux_x(mission)+.16,-.78
        b.cyl('driver-hatch-gasket',.295,.018,(hx,hy,TOP+.009),'rubber',verts=48,bevel=0)
        b.cyl('driver-hatch',.278,.025,(hx,hy,TOP+.028),'paint',verts=48,bevel=.008)
        b.cyl('hatch-hinge',.027,.22,(hx-.255,hy,TOP+.04),'gunmetal',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=12,bevel=.003)
        b.tube('hatch-grab',[(hx+.06,hy-.10,TOP+.043),(hx+.06,hy-.10,TOP+.09),(hx+.06,hy+.10,TOP+.09),(hx+.06,hy+.10,TOP+.043)],.012,'paint_dark',smooth=False)
    for y in (-.51,.51):
        _panel(b,'rear-service',(-3.02,y-.39,TOP),(1,0,0),(0,1,0),(.78,.78))
        for dx in (-2.93,-2.47):
            b.cyl('service-hinge',.018,.12,(dx,y+.37,TOP+.028),'gunmetal',rot=(0,PI/2,0),verts=12,bevel=.003)
        b.box('service-latch',(.1,.035,.018),(-2.63,y-.32,TOP+.032),'gunmetal',bevel=.004)
    for side in (-1,1):
        at=Vector((BACK-.031,side*1.13,1.58))
        b.box('tail-housing',(.08,.32,.18),at,'paint_dark',bevel=.016)
        b.box('tail-recess',(.014,.275,.126),at+Vector((-.045,0,0)),'black',bevel=.006)
        for dy,mat in ((-.09,'amber'),(0,'red'),(.09,'lamp')):
            b.box('tail-lens',(.02,.072,.085),at+Vector((-.057,dy,0)),mat,bevel=.007)
        _grille(b,'rear-vent',(BACK-.02,side*1.13,1.95),(0,-1,0),(0,0,1),(.30,.34))
        b.box('rear-tow-lug',(.12,.16,.12),(BACK-.03,side*.68,.88),'paint_dark',bevel=.012)
        b.cyl('rear-tow-pin',.035,.19,(BACK-.10,side*.68,.89),'gunmetal',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=12,bevel=.004)
        b.tube('rear-shackle',[(BACK-.13,side*.68+.065*math.sin(a),.79+.10*math.cos(a)) for a in [2*PI*k/14 for k in range(15)]],.023,'steel',smooth=False)
    b.box('tow-crossmember',(.16,1.36,.12),(BACK+.01,0,.65),'gunmetal',bevel=.02)
    b.box('pintle-mount',(.12,.23,.17),(BACK-.09,0,.82),'paint_dark',bevel=.014)
    b.tube('pintle',[(BACK-.13,0,.88),(BACK-.26,0,.77),(BACK-.29,0,.86)],.038,'gunmetal',smooth=False)


def _running_gear(b):
    for i, x in enumerate(AXLES):
        b.cyl('axle', 0.08, TRACK * 2 - 0.5, (x, 0, R), 'gunmetal', rot=(PI / 2, 0, 0), verts=16)
        b.sphere('diff', 0.18, (x, 0, R), 'gunmetal', scale=(1, 0.8, 0.9))
        for s in (-1, 1):
            _wheel(b, f'wheel{i}{s:+d}', (x, s * TRACK, R), s)
            b.box('lower-arm', (0.12, 0.42, 0.08), (x - 0.1, s * 0.72, R - 0.12), 'gunmetal', bevel=0.02)
            b.cyl('damper', 0.05, 0.6, (x - 0.22, s * 0.78, R + 0.32), 'steel', rot=(s * 0.25, 0, 0), verts=12)
    b.box('driveline', (AXLES[0] - AXLES[3], 0.12, 0.12), ((AXLES[0] + AXLES[3]) / 2, 0, R + 0.05), 'gunmetal', bevel=0.02)


def _crane(b):
    """Rear-facing telescopic recovery crane with pinned cheeks, lift ram, winch and hanging hook."""
    pivot=Vector((BACK+.70,0,TOP+.73))
    b.cyl('crane-slew',.49,.13,(pivot.x,0,TOP+.065),'gunmetal',verts=48,bevel=.015)
    b.cyl('crane-pedestal',.37,.22,(pivot.x,0,TOP+.22),'paint_dark',verts=32,bevel=.016)
    bolts=Batch(b,'slew-bolts','steel')
    for k in range(16):
        a=2*PI*k/16
        bolts.cyl(.023,.025,(pivot.x+.43*math.cos(a),.43*math.sin(a),TOP+.143),verts=6)
    bolts.done()
    for side in (-1,1):
        b.wedge('crane-cheek',[(-.45,-.48),(.40,-.48),(.30,.19),(-.17,.31),(-.41,.08)],.095,
                pivot+Vector((0,side*.31,0)),'paint',bevel=.022)
        b.cyl('boom-pivot',.095,.12,pivot+Vector((0,side*.34,0)),'gunmetal',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=24,bevel=.008)
        b.cyl('pivot-cap',.065,.02,pivot+Vector((0,side*.412,0)),'steel',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=12,bevel=.003)
    angle=math.radians(17)
    d=Vector((-math.cos(angle),0,math.sin(angle)))
    length=2.18
    rot=(0,angle,0)
    b.box('crane-boom',(length,.39,.40),pivot+d*(length/2-.10),'paint',rot=rot,bevel=.025)
    tip=pivot+d*3.08
    b.box('telescopic-stage',(1.40,.285,.285),pivot+d*2.43,'paint_dark',rot=rot,bevel=.018)
    b.box('boom-end-collar',(.16,.455,.46),pivot+d*1.98,'gunmetal',rot=rot,bevel=.012)
    b.box('boom-end-sleeve',(.11,.415,.42),pivot+d*2.055,'paint',rot=rot,bevel=.012)
    for side in (-1,1):
        for along in (.35,1.60):
            b.box('boom-service-cover',(.36,.028,.25),pivot+d*along+Vector((0,side*.21,0)),'paint_dark',rot=rot,bevel=.01)
            for dx in (-.13,.13):
                b.cyl('boom-cover-bolt',.019,.018,pivot+d*(along+dx)+Vector((0,side*.234,0)),'steel',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=6,bevel=0)
    low=pivot+Vector((.12,-.40,-.41)); high=pivot+d*1.38+Vector((0,-.40,-.23))
    delta=high-low
    b.tube('lift-cylinder',[low,low+delta*.65],.087,'paint_dark',smooth=False)
    b.tube('lift-piston',[low+delta*.57,high],.044,'chrome',smooth=False)
    for endpoint in (low,high):
        b.cyl('ram-pin',.065,.46,endpoint,'gunmetal',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=16,bevel=.006)
    for side in (-1,1):
        b.tube('hydraulic-hose',[pivot+Vector((.22,side*.25,-.38)),pivot+Vector((.42,side*.25,-.13)),
                               pivot+d*.45+Vector((0,side*.235,.23)),pivot+d*1.80+Vector((0,side*.235,.23))],.015,'cable')
        b.box('sheave-cheek',(.28,.04,.33),tip+Vector((0,side*.17,0)),'paint',rot=rot,bevel=.02)
    b.cyl('tip-sheave',.125,.27,tip,'gunmetal',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=32,bevel=.008)
    # Drum behind the pivot, cable routed across the boom to the sheave.
    drum=pivot+Vector((.34,0,-.19))
    b.cyl('winch-drum',.15,.41,drum,'gunmetal',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=32,bevel=.01)
    winding=Batch(b,'winch-winding','cable')
    for k in range(13):
        # Thin coaxial discs read as tightly wound cable in silhouette.
        winding.cyl(.157,.019,drum+Vector((0,-.18+k*.03,0)),(PI/2,0,0),verts=24)
    winding.done()
    b.tube('hoist-cable',[drum+Vector((0,0,.15)),pivot+d*.38+Vector((0,0,.235)),tip+Vector((0,0,.125)),tip+Vector((0,0,-.64))],.013,'cable',smooth=False)
    hook=tip+Vector((0,0,-.74))
    b.box('hook-block',(.18,.20,.25),hook,'paint_dark',bevel=.025)
    b.cyl('hook-block-pin',.053,.23,hook,'steel',rot=(PI/2,0,0),verts=16,bevel=.004)
    b.tube('recovery-hook',[hook+Vector((0,0,-.12)),hook+Vector((0,0,-.29)),hook+Vector((-.08,0,-.38)),
                             hook+Vector((-.20,0,-.34)),hook+Vector((-.21,0,-.23))],.035,'steel')
    b.tube('hook-latch',[hook+Vector((-.20,0,-.23)),hook+Vector((0,0,-.19))],.009,'gunmetal',smooth=False)
    # Rear stabiliser remains clear of the ground and rear door.
    b.box('stabiliser-blade',(.12,2.10,.40),(BACK-.23,0,.53),'paint_dark',rot=(0,.20,0),bevel=.025)
    b.box('spade-cutting-edge',(.14,2.16,.065),(BACK-.19,0,.34),'steel',bevel=.008)
    for y in (-.83,.83):
        b.tube('spade-cylinder',[(BACK+.03,y,1.03),(BACK-.20,y,.66)],.065,'paint_dark',smooth=False)
        b.tube('spade-piston',[(BACK-.12,y,.76),(BACK-.25,y,.53)],.035,'steel',smooth=False)



def _mounts(mission, top=TOP):
    roof_x = -0.3
    deck_x = BACK + 1.25
    deck_length = 2.0
    rear_sensor_x, rear_sensor_y = BACK + 2.4, 1.05
    if mission == 'RECOVERY':
        # Reserve the rear crane circle, then cabin, then the full-size weapon ring.
        deck_x, deck_length, roof_x = -1.55, 1.4, .15
        # Rear sensors stand on the flat roof between the cabin and the crane, not out over the chamfer (fit.py).
        rear_sensor_x, rear_sensor_y = -2.62, 1.0
    if mission == 'TROOP':
        roof_x = 0.0
    return Mounts(
        front=FRONT + 0.05, back=BACK, axles=AXLES, wheel_r=R, track=TRACK, tyre_w=TYRE_W,
        deck=(deck_x, top), deck_size=(deck_length, 2.1),
        roof=(roof_x, 0.0, top), roof2=(_aux_x(mission), -0.72, top),
        side=(BACK + 0.4, ROOF_FRONT - 0.1, SPONSON_Z0 + 0.04, SPONSON_Z1, SPONSON + 0.04),
        front_face=(GLACIS_X + 0.2, 1.05, GLACIS_Z - 0.05, 1.05),
        roof_span=(BACK + 0.2, ROOF_FRONT - 0.05, top, 1.15), belly=(BACK + 0.4, GLACIS_X, 0.52, 0.75),
        engine=(1.38, 0.62, top), tanks=(BACK + 0.08, BACK + 0.64, 0.95, 1.0),
        antenna_left=(BACK + 0.45, -1.0, top), antenna_right=(BACK + 0.45, 1.0, top), radio_mast=(BACK + 0.35, 0.75, top),
        optics=(ROOF_FRONT - 0.25, 0.85, top), sensor_mast=(_mast_x(mission), 0.97, top),
        corners=((ROOF_FRONT - 0.1, -1.05, top), (ROOF_FRONT - 0.1, 1.05, top), (rear_sensor_x, -rear_sensor_y, top), (rear_sensor_x, rear_sensor_y, top)),
        bumper=(FRONT + 0.05, 1.15), hitch=(BACK - 0.1, 0.82), rack=(BACK + 2.75, 0.0, top),
        extra={'armoured': True, 'module_h': 1.15, 'rear_ramp': mission == 'TROOP', 'recovery': mission == 'RECOVERY', 'driver_hatch': mission not in ('COMMAND', 'MINE')},
    )


def build(mats, mission):
    b = Builder('base', mats)
    _hull(b, mission)
    for side in (-1, 1):
        _side(b, side, mission)
    _cheeks(b)
    _front(b, mission)
    _roof(b, mission)
    _running_gear(b)
    if mission == 'RECOVERY':
        _crane(b)
    if mission == 'COMBAT':
        b.revolve('turret-mount-flange', [(.87, -.014), (.95, -.014), (.95, .014), (.87, .014)], (-.3, 0, TOP), 'gunmetal', rot=(PI/2,0,0), steps=64)
    return _mounts(mission)

"""Muzzle sightline check: in every still, each gun's muzzle stands clear of every other part (owner FIX, G2).

    blender -b --factory-startup -P sightline.py -- [--vehicles combat,recce|all] [--parts FP-C,SA-A|all]
                                                    [--shots hero,front,rear|all] [--report] [--write-baseline]

Builds each vehicle with every listed part at the stills' full detail and frames the camera exactly as
art/blender/render.py frames its stills: the hero (only the hero loadout, fleet.HERO) and the two build angles (every
part). For each barrel it takes the muzzle zone on screen: from the muzzle (the tip of the brake where there is one)
along the barrel's line AHEAD of the frame width, where the eye carries the barrel on. A part that a team may fit
with that gun (any other slot) must stand CLEAR of that zone on screen, whether it stands in front of the muzzle or
behind it: the owner saw the crew cupola (SA-A) hide the heavy gun's muzzle in the combat hero still, and, moved
behind the muzzle, still carry the barrel on as if it were its end. Parts the barrel's body crosses, short of the
muzzle, stay readable and are not judged. The hull's own small fittings (mirrors, lamps, aerials: FITTING) are judged
like parts: the combat hero's driver's mirror stood at the cannon's muzzle and read as its brake (G2 sweep).

Hero stills (the chooser's large picture) must be clean. Build stills, whose every combination of a team's parts is
possible, may fail only on the pairs recorded in sightline-baseline.json, each no closer than recorded: a new pair or a
closer one fails, in any run, filtered or not. --write-baseline rewrites the record after a whole-fleet run and refuses
to add a pair, so the record only shrinks, to empty by G4 (MPES §17). With --report, prints every pair's clearance.

import json
import os
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

import numpy as np  # noqa: E402

from sea import fleet, materials, scene  # noqa: E402
from sea.geo import Builder  # noqa: E402
from sea.mounts import SLOTS  # noqa: E402
from sea.parts.library import PARTS, build as build_part  # noqa: E402

WEAPONS = ('weapon', 'aux-weapon')
CLEAR = 0.01     # of the frame width: 13 px in a 1280 px build still, 16 px in the hero
AHEAD = 0.04     # of the frame width beyond the tip, where the eye carries the barrel on
SLACK = 0.5      # px a recorded pair may move closer by before it counts as worse (float noise between runs)
MUZZLE = ('muzzle-collar', 'muzzle-bridges')   # brake pieces beyond the bored barrel's end
BASELINE = os.path.join(HERE, 'sightline-baseline.json')
FITTING = 0.8    # m: a hull object no bigger than this across (mirror, lamp, aerial, shackle) is judged like a part


def fittings():
    """The hull's small fittings, grouped by name as 'hull:<name>' -> objects. The hull body and the wheels, which
    every barrel crosses as ground, are larger and are not judged; a mirror at a muzzle reads as its brake (G2 sweep)."""
    out = {}
    for o in scene.layer_objects('base'):
        if o.type in ('MESH', 'CURVE') and max(o.dimensions) <= FITTING:
            out.setdefault('hull:' + o.name.split(':')[1], []).append(o)
    return out


def layer_tris(layer, objs=None):
    """World-space triangles (n, 3, 3) of one layer's evaluated surfaces (or of `objs`)."""
    deps = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    out = []
    for o in scene.layer_objects(layer) if objs is None else objs:
        if o.type not in ('MESH', 'CURVE'):
            continue
        ev = o.evaluated_get(deps)
        me = ev.to_mesh()
        if me is None:
            continue
        me.calc_loop_triangles()
        mw = np.array(ev.matrix_world)
        v = np.array([x.co for x in me.vertices], dtype=float).reshape(-1, 3)
        v = v @ mw[:3, :3].T + mw[:3, 3]
        t = np.array([tri.vertices[:] for tri in me.loop_triangles], dtype=int).reshape(-1, 3)
        if len(t):
            out.append(v[t])
        ev.to_mesh_clear()

    deps = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()

    mw = np.array(ev.matrix_world)

def barrels(layer):
    """(name, breech, muzzle) world points of each barrel of a weapon layer. The muzzle is the end away from the mount,
    carried on to the far face of any brake on the barrel's line (sea/parts/fp.py stands the last collar beyond it)."""
    objs = [o for o in scene.layer_objects(layer) if o.type == 'MESH']
    lo, hi = scene.bounds(scene.layer_objects(layer))
    centre = np.array((lo + hi) / 2)
    brake = [world_verts(o) for o in objs if o.name.split(':')[1:2] and o.name.split(':')[1] in MUZZLE]
    found = []
    for o in objs:
        if o.name.split(':')[1:2] != ['bored-barrel']:
            continue
        v = world_verts(o)
        mean = v.mean(axis=0)
        axis = np.linalg.svd(v - mean, full_matrices=False)[2][0]
        s = (v - mean) @ axis
        radius = np.linalg.norm((v - mean) - np.outer(s, axis), axis=1).max()
        a, b = mean + axis * s.min(), mean + axis * s.max()
        if np.linalg.norm(a - centre) > np.linalg.norm(b - centre):
            a, b, axis = b, a, -axis
        reach = (b - mean) @ axis
        for w in brake:
            t = (w - mean) @ axis
            off = np.linalg.norm((w - mean) - np.outer(t, axis), axis=1)
            near = off < radius * 2.5     # this barrel's brake, not a twin's
            if near.any():
                reach = max(reach, t[near].max())
        found.append((o.name, a, mean + axis * reach))
    return found


class View:
    """Camera-space transform and pixel projection, as bpy_extras.object_utils.world_to_camera_view, vectorised."""

    def __init__(self, cam, size):
        sc = bpy.context.scene
        inv = np.array(cam.matrix_world.normalized().inverted())
        self.rot, self.off = inv[:3, :3], inv[:3, 3]
        f = [np.array(v) for v in cam.data.view_frame(scene=sc)[:3]]
        self.d = -f[0][2]                       # the frame's distance in front of the camera
        self.x0, self.x1 = f[2][0], f[1][0]
        self.y0, self.y1 = f[1][1], f[0][1]
        self.size = size

    def local(self, points):
        """Camera-space points with depth (distance in front of the camera) last, positive ahead."""
        q = points @ self.rot.T + self.off
        return np.concatenate([q[..., :2], -q[..., 2:3]], axis=-1)

    def pixels(self, local):
        """Pixel coordinates (x right, y up) of camera-space points (..., 3)."""
        k = self.d / np.maximum(local[..., 2:3], 1e-9)
        xy = local[..., :2] * k
        return np.stack([(xy[..., 0] - self.x0) / (self.x1 - self.x0) * self.size[0],
                         (xy[..., 1] - self.y0) / (self.y1 - self.y0) * self.size[1]], axis=-1)


def seg_dist(p, a, b):
    """Distance from points p (..., 2) to segment a-b."""
    ab = b - a
    t = np.clip(((p - a) @ ab) / max(ab @ ab, 1e-12), 0, 1)
    return np.linalg.norm(p - (a + t[..., None] * ab), axis=-1)


def clearance(tris2, a, b):
    """Smallest on-screen distance from segment a-b to 2D triangles (n, 3, 2); 0 where they overlap.
    A triangle seen edge-on (no area) is only its edges: it covers nothing, it can still be near."""
    if not len(tris2):
        return float('inf')
    best = seg_dist(tris2, a, b).min()
    # Segment ends to triangle edges, and the segment crossing or lying inside a triangle.
    for p in (a, b):
        for i in range(3):
            e0, e1 = tris2[:, i], tris2[:, (i + 1) % 3]
            ab = e1 - e0
            t = np.clip(np.einsum('ij,ij->i', p - e0, ab) / np.maximum(np.einsum('ij,ij->i', ab, ab), 1e-12), 0, 1)
            best = min(best, np.linalg.norm(p - (e0 + t[:, None] * ab), axis=1).min())

    def cross(u, v):
        return u[..., 0] * v[..., 1] - u[..., 1] * v[..., 0]
    solid = np.abs(cross(tris2[:, 1] - tris2[:, 0], tris2[:, 2] - tris2[:, 0])) > 1e-6
    for p in (a, b, (a + b) / 2):
        d = [cross(tris2[:, (i + 1) % 3] - tris2[:, i], p - tris2[:, i]) for i in range(3)]
        if np.any(solid & (((d[0] >= 0) & (d[1] >= 0) & (d[2] >= 0)) | ((d[0] <= 0) & (d[1] <= 0) & (d[2] <= 0)))):
            return 0.0
    for i in range(3):
        e0, e1 = tris2[:, i], tris2[:, (i + 1) % 3]
        d1, d2 = cross(e1 - e0, a - e0), cross(e1 - e0, b - e0)
        d3, d4 = cross(b - a, e0 - a), cross(b - a, e1 - a)
        if np.any((d1 * d2 < 0) & (d3 * d4 < 0)):
            return 0.0
    return float(best)


def selftest():
    """The geometry on cases with known answers, so a regression fails before any judgement."""
    a, b = np.array([0., 0.]), np.array([10., 0.])
    tri = np.array([[[2., -1.], [4., -1.], [3., 1.]]])
    assert clearance(tri, a, b) == 0.0, 'crossing triangle'
    assert abs(clearance(np.array([[[2., 5.], [4., 5.], [3., 7.]]]), a, b) - 5.0) < 1e-9, 'triangle above'
    flat = np.array([[[0., 3.], [5., 3.], [10., 3.]]])
    assert abs(clearance(flat, a, b) - 3.0) < 1e-9, 'edge-on triangle off the line'
    assert clearance(np.array([[[1., 0.], [5., 0.], [9., 0.]]]), a, b) == 0.0, 'edge-on triangle on the line'


def key(stem, shot, gun, other):
    return f'{stem} {shot} {gun} {other}'


def main():
    argv = sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--') + 1:] if '--' in sys.argv else []
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('--vehicles', default='all')
    p.add_argument('--parts', default='all')
    p.add_argument('--shots', default='all')
    p.add_argument('--report', action='store_true')
    p.add_argument('--write-baseline', action='store_true')
    a = p.parse_args(argv)
    selftest()
    vehicles = list(fleet.VEHICLES) if a.vehicles == 'all' else [v for v in a.vehicles.split(',') if v]
    parts = list(PARTS) if a.parts == 'all' else [c for c in a.parts.split(',') if c]
    whole = a.vehicles == 'all' and a.parts == 'all' and a.shots == 'all'
    if a.write_baseline and not whole:
        sys.exit('[sightline] --write-baseline needs the whole fleet: --vehicles all --parts all --shots all')
    baseline = {}
    if os.path.exists(BASELINE):
        with open(BASELINE, encoding='utf-8') as f:
            baseline = json.load(f)['pairs']
    seen = {}       # failing pair -> closest clearance over its barrels
    checked = 0
    for stem in vehicles:
        scene.reset()
        mats = materials.realtime_palette()     # materials do not change shape; geo.REALTIME stays off, as in render.py
        m = fleet.VEHICLES[stem](mats)
        for card in PARTS:
            build_part(card, Builder(card, mats), m)
        cam = scene.camera(lens=55)
        everything = ['base', *PARTS]
        hero = list(fleet.HERO[stem])
        shots = [('hero', HERO, 32, 8, ['base', *hero], hero),
                 *[(angle, BUILD, yaw, pitch, everything, list(PARTS)) for angle, (yaw, pitch) in ANGLES.items()]]
        tris = {layer: layer_tris(layer) for layer in PARTS}
        hull = fittings()
        tris.update({name: layer_tris(None, objs) for name, objs in hull.items()})
        shots = [s for s in shots if a.shots == 'all' or s[0] in a.shots.split(',')]
        for shot, size, yaw, pitch, framing, shown in shots:
            sc = bpy.context.scene
            sc.render.resolution_x, sc.render.resolution_y, sc.render.resolution_percentage = size[0], size[1], 100
            framed = [o for layer in framing for o in scene.layer_objects(layer)]
            lo, hi = scene.bounds(framed)
            scene.fit(cam, (lo + hi) / 2, yaw, pitch, framed, 1.06)
            bpy.context.view_layer.update()
            view = View(cam, size)
            shown = [*shown, *hull]     # every still shows the hull
            local = {layer: view.local(tris[layer]) for layer in shown if len(tris[layer])}
            limit = CLEAR * size[0]
            for gun in [c for c in shown if SLOTS.get(c) in WEAPONS]:
                for barrel, breech, muzzle in barrels(gun):
                    ends = view.local(np.array([breech, muzzle]))
                    back, tip = view.pixels(ends)
                    on = tip - back
                    zone = (tip, tip + on / max(np.linalg.norm(on), 1e-9) * AHEAD * size[0])
                    for other in shown:
                        if SLOTS.get(other) == SLOTS[gun] or other not in local or (gun not in parts and other not in parts):
                            continue    # a filtered run checks every pair a selected part is in, gun or not
                        d = clearance(view.pixels(local[other]), *zone)
                        checked += 1
                        k = key(stem, shot, gun, other)
                        if d < limit:
                            seen[k] = min(seen.get(k, float('inf')), d)
                        if d < limit or a.report:
                            print(f'[sightline] {"near" if d < limit else "ok  "} {stem:14s} {shot:5s} {gun:5s} {barrel:20s} '
                                  f'x {other:6s} ({SLOTS.get(other, "hull")}): {d:6.1f} px (need {limit:.0f})', flush=True)
    new = sorted(k for k in seen if k not in baseline or k.split()[1] == 'hero')
    worse = sorted(k for k in seen if k in baseline and seen[k] < baseline[k] - SLACK)
    gone = sorted(k for k in baseline if k not in seen and k.split()[0] in vehicles
                  and (a.shots == 'all' or k.split()[1] in a.shots.split(','))
                  and any(c in parts for c in (k.split()[2], k.split()[3])))
    for k in new:
        print(f'[sightline] FAIL new pair {k}: {seen[k]:.1f} px', flush=True)
    for k in worse:
        print(f'[sightline] FAIL closer {k}: {seen[k]:.1f} px, recorded {baseline[k]:.1f}', flush=True)
    if gone:
        print(f'[sightline] {len(gone)} recorded pair(s) now clear: shrink the record with --write-baseline', flush=True)
    by_shot = {}
    for k in seen:
        by_shot[k.split()[1]] = by_shot.get(k.split()[1], 0) + 1
    bad = new or worse
    print(f'[sightline] {"FAIL" if bad else "PASS"} {len(seen)} of {checked} muzzle-part pair(s) closer than '
          f'{CLEAR:.0%} of the frame ({", ".join(f"{s} {n}" for s, n in sorted(by_shot.items())) or "none"}); '
          f'{len(new)} new, {len(worse)} closer, {len(baseline)} recorded', flush=True)
    if a.write_baseline:
        if bad:
            sys.exit('[sightline] not written: the record may only shrink')
        with open(BASELINE, 'w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as f:
            json.dump({'note': 'Build-still muzzle pairs still to clear in G4 (MPES §17); only ever shrinks. '
                               'Written by sightline.py --write-baseline.',
                       # a recorded clearance never goes down, so repeated rewrites cannot add up the slack
                       'pairs': {k: max(round(seen[k], 1), baseline.get(k, 0)) for k in sorted(seen)}}, f, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False)
            f.write('\n')
        print(f'[sightline] record written: {len(seen)} pair(s)', flush=True)
    sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

### art/blender/tris.py

```python
"""Triangle budget check at real-time detail (what the game embeds).

    blender -b --factory-startup -P tris.py -- [--vehicles combat,recce|all] [--parts CAP-A,CAP-B|none|all]

Builds each vehicle and the listed parts exactly as art/blender/export.py does (geo.REALTIME = True, modifiers
applied) and prints the triangles of every layer, plus the part on the compact card mount. Exits 1 if a budget is
exceeded.
"""
import argparse
import os
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)

import bpy  # noqa: E402

from sea import fleet, geo, materials, scene  # noqa: E402
from sea.geo import Builder  # noqa: E402
from sea.mounts import card_mount  # noqa: E402
from sea.parts.library import PARTS, build as build_part  # noqa: E402

BASE_MAX = 90_000
PART_MAX = 8_000
RUNNING_MAX = 32_000  # MOB-B, MOB-C, MOB-D, MOB-G: a full set of running gear


def budget(layer):
    if layer == 'base':
        return BASE_MAX
    return RUNNING_MAX if layer in ('MOB-B', 'MOB-C', 'MOB-D', 'MOB-G') else PART_MAX


def count():
    deps = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
    tris = {}
    for o in bpy.context.scene.objects:
        if 'sea_layer' not in o or o.type not in ('MESH', 'CURVE'):
            continue
        me = o.evaluated_get(deps).to_mesh()
        if me is None:
            continue
        me.calc_loop_triangles()
        tris[o['sea_layer']] = tris.get(o['sea_layer'], 0) + len(me.loop_triangles)
        o.evaluated_get(deps).to_mesh_clear()
    return tris


def main():
    argv = sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--') + 1:] if '--' in sys.argv else []
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('--vehicles', default='all')
    p.add_argument('--parts', default='all')
    a = p.parse_args(argv)
    vehicles = list(fleet.VEHICLES) if a.vehicles == 'all' else [v for v in a.vehicles.split(',') if v]
    parts = [] if a.parts == 'none' else list(PARTS) if a.parts == 'all' else [c for c in a.parts.split(',') if c]
    over = []
    geo.REALTIME = True
    for stem in vehicles:
        scene.reset()
        mats = materials.realtime_palette()
        m = fleet.VEHICLES[stem](mats)
        for card in parts:
            build_part(card, Builder(card, mats), m)
        for layer, n in sorted(count().items()):
            flag = '  OVER BUDGET' if n > budget(layer) else ''
            print(f'[tris] {stem:14s} {layer:8s} {n:7d} / {budget(layer)}{flag}', flush=True)
            if flag:
                over.append((stem, layer, n))
    for card in parts:
        scene.reset()
        mats = materials.realtime_palette()
        build_part(card, Builder(card, mats), card_mount())
        n = sum(count().values())
        print(f'[tris] card-mount     {card:8s} {n:7d}', flush=True)
    print(f'[tris] {"FAIL" if over else "PASS"} {len(over)} layer(s) over budget', flush=True)
    sys.exit(1 if over else 0)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

```ts
// Still-angle analysis (owner FIX, G2): which camera angles show the vehicles' parts best. Renders the packed model
// (content/models/showcase.glb) in headless Chromium from a grid of yaw and pitch, framed as art/blender/render.py
// frames a build still (55 mm lens on a 36 mm sensor, every layer of the vehicle in frame, margin 1.06), and counts
// each part's visible pixels with only the base in front of it: in the layered stills a team shows at most one part
// per mount, so parts never hide one another. Prints per vehicle the best front and rear angles and writes the grid.
//
//   node art/tools/angles.ts [out.json]
//
// Yaw and pitch follow art/blender/sea/scene.py: yaw 0 looks at the vehicle's left side, 90 at its front.
import { build } from 'esbuild';
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';
import { chromium } from '@playwright/test';

const out = process.argv[2] ?? '.artifacts/angles.json';
// A 10° grid plus the current build angles (render.py ANGLES: front 38/10, rear 218/12).
const YAWS = [...Array.from({ length: 36 }, (_, i) => i * 10), 38, 218].sort((a, b) => a - b);
const PITCHES = [6, 10, 12, 14, 18, 22, 26, 30, 35];
const SIZE = { width: 480, height: 270 };

const page = `
import { Box3, Color, Mesh, MeshBasicMaterial, PerspectiveCamera, Scene, Vector3, WebGLRenderer } from 'three';
import { GLTFLoader } from 'three/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js';
const layerOf = o => String(o.userData.layer ?? o.name);
window.analyse = async (yaws, pitches, size) => {
  const glb = await (await fetch('http://sea.local/model.glb')).arrayBuffer();
  const root = (await new GLTFLoader().parseAsync(glb, '')).scene;
  const renderer = new WebGLRenderer({ antialias: false, preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
  renderer.setSize(size.width, size.height, false);
  const gl = renderer.getContext();
  const pixels = new Uint8Array(size.width * size.height * 4);
  const hFov = 2 * Math.atan(18 / 55), tanH = Math.tan(hFov / 2), tanV = tanH * size.height / size.width;
  const camera = new PerspectiveCamera(2 * Math.atan(tanV) * 180 / Math.PI, size.width / size.height, 0.05, 500);
  const result = {};
  for (const vehicle of root.children) {
    const scene = new Scene();
    scene.background = new Color(1, 1, 1);
    const copy = vehicle.clone();
    scene.add(copy);
    copy.updateMatrixWorld(true);
    const box = new Box3().setFromObject(copy), centre = box.getCenter(new Vector3());
    const corners = [];
    for (const x of [box.min.x, box.max.x]) for (const y of [box.min.y, box.max.y]) for (const z of [box.min.z, box.max.z]) corners.push(new Vector3(x, y, z));
    const base = copy.children.filter(n => layerOf(n) === 'base');
    const parts = copy.children.filter(n => layerOf(n) !== 'base');
    const black = new MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x000000 });
    const red = new MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff0000 });
    const paint = (nodes, material) => nodes.forEach(n => n.traverse(o => { if (o instanceof Mesh) o.material = material; }));
    paint(base, black); paint(parts, red);
    const counts = {};
    for (const yaw of yaws) for (const pitch of pitches) {
      const y = yaw * Math.PI / 180, p = pitch * Math.PI / 180;
      // Blender (x, y, z) is glTF (x, z, -y).
      const dir = new Vector3(Math.sin(y) * Math.cos(p), Math.sin(p), Math.cos(y) * Math.cos(p));
      camera.position.copy(centre).addScaledVector(dir, 50);
      camera.lookAt(centre);
      camera.updateMatrixWorld();
      // Distance that fits every corner, then the margin; the subject is centred on its projected extents.
      const inv = camera.matrixWorldInverse;
      let distance = 0;
      for (const c of corners) {
        // v.z is minus the depth from the camera, 50 away: the corner sits 50 + v.z nearer the camera than the centre.
        const v = c.clone().applyMatrix4(inv), nearer = 50 + v.z;
        distance = Math.max(distance, Math.abs(v.x) / tanH + nearer, Math.abs(v.y) / tanV + nearer);
      }
      camera.position.copy(centre).addScaledVector(dir, distance * 1.06);
      camera.updateMatrixWorld();
      const key = yaw + '/' + pitch, row = {};
      // Sanity: the whole vehicle with every part fills a fair share of the frame.
      parts.forEach(n => { n.visible = true; });
      renderer.render(scene, camera);
      gl.readPixels(0, 0, size.width, size.height, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, pixels);
      let filled = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < pixels.length; i += 4) if (pixels[i] < 250 || pixels[i + 1] < 250) filled++;
      row.filled = filled / (size.width * size.height);
      for (const part of parts) {
        parts.forEach(n => { n.visible = n === part; });
        renderer.render(scene, camera);
        gl.readPixels(0, 0, size.width, size.height, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, pixels);
        let n = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < pixels.length; i += 4) if (pixels[i] > 200 && pixels[i + 1] < 60) n++;
        row[layerOf(part)] = n;
      }
      counts[key] = row;
    }
    result[vehicle.name] = counts;
    console.log('[angles] ' + vehicle.name);
  }
  return result;
};
`;
const bundle = await build({ stdin: { contents: page, resolveDir: resolve('.'), loader: 'js' }, bundle: true, write: false, format: 'iife', minify: true });
const browser = await chromium.launch({ args: ['--use-angle=swiftshader', '--enable-unsafe-swiftshader'] });
const tab = await browser.newPage();
tab.on('console', m => { if (m.text().startsWith('[angles]')) console.log(m.text()); });
await tab.route('http://sea.local/**', route => route.request().url().endsWith('/model.glb')
  ? route.fulfill({ body: readFileSync('content/models/showcase.glb'), contentType: 'model/gltf-binary' })
  : route.fulfill({ body: '<!doctype html><title>angles</title>', contentType: 'text/html' }));
await tab.goto('http://sea.local/');
await tab.addScriptTag({ content: bundle.outputFiles[0]!.text });
type Grid = Record<string, Record<string, Record<string, number>>>;
const grid = await tab.evaluate(([y, p, s]) => (window as unknown as { analyse: (...a: unknown[]) => Promise<unknown> }).analyse(y, p, s), [YAWS, PITCHES, SIZE] as const) as Grid;
await browser.close();
writeFileSync(out, JSON.stringify({ yaws: YAWS, pitches: PITCHES, size: SIZE, grid }));

// Score of one angle: the sum over parts of log(1 + visible pixels), which rewards showing every part over
// enlarging the big ones. A pair is scored on its front angle alone (the view a tracker opens on) plus, per part,
// the better of the two (what the player can see by switching). Front angles have the camera ahead of the
// vehicle's middle (yaw 0..90 or 270..360), rear angles behind it.
const partsOf = (row: Record<string, number>) => Object.entries(row).filter(([k]) => k !== 'filled');
const score = (row: Record<string, number>) => partsOf(row).reduce((s, [, n]) => s + Math.log1p(n), 0);
const front = (yaw: number) => yaw <= 90 || yaw >= 270;
for (const [vehicle, counts] of Object.entries(grid)) {
  const keys = Object.keys(counts);
  let best = { s: -1, f: '', r: '' };
  for (const f of keys.filter(k => front(Number(k.split('/')[0])))) for (const r of keys.filter(k => !front(Number(k.split('/')[0])))) {
    const a = counts[f]!, b = counts[r]!;
    const s = score(a) + partsOf(a).map(([k]) => k).reduce((t, part) => t + Math.log1p(Math.max(a[part]!, b[part]!)), 0);
    if (s > best.s) best = { s, f, r };
  }
  const current = (k: string) => `${score(counts[k]!).toFixed(1)}, fills ${Math.round(counts[k]!['filled']! * 100)}%`;
  const hidden = (k: string) => partsOf(counts[k]!).filter(([, n]) => n < 200).map(([p]) => p).join(' ') || '-';
  console.log(`${vehicle}: best front ${best.f} (${current(best.f)}), rear ${best.r} (${current(best.r)}); current front 38/10 (${current('38/10')}), rear 218/12 (${current('218/12')})`);
  console.log(`  barely visible (<200 px): best front ${hidden(best.f)} | best rear ${hidden(best.r)} | current front ${hidden('38/10')} | current rear ${hidden('218/12')}`);
}

### art/tools/build-composites.ts

Paths: `art/tools/build-composites.ts`. SHA-256 `dab6d3bd7899f6c7647b9cee0546e5e75e70bc0d8887c8e99728db333cf9c0c5`, 1440 bytes.

```ts
// Review aid: each vehicle's base with one part per slot (variant letter A..G), stacked farthest first by the
// recorded camera distance, as the stills showcase draws them. Feed the results to contact-sheet.ts.
//   node art/tools/build-composites.ts <renders dir> <out dir> <letters, e.g. A,D,G>
import sharp from 'sharp';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';

const [dir, out, letters] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!dir || !out || !letters) throw new Error('usage: build-composites.ts <renders dir> <out dir> <letters>');
const manifest = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(dir, 'renders.json'), 'utf8')) as { outputs: { file: string; depth: number | null }[] };
const depth = new Map(manifest.outputs.map(e => [e.file, e.depth ?? 0]));
const vehicles = ['combat', 'recce', 'troop-carrier', 'command-post', 'recovery', 'mine-clearing'];
const slots = ['ACC', 'CAP', 'COM', 'FP', 'MOB', 'PRO', 'SA'];
for (const letter of letters.split(',')) {
  for (const v of vehicles) for (const angle of ['front', 'rear']) {
    const layers = slots.map(s => `${v}-${angle}-${s}-${letter}.png`).sort((a, b) => (depth.get(b) ?? 0) - (depth.get(a) ?? 0));
    await sharp(join(dir, `${v}-${angle}-base.png`)).composite(layers.map(f => ({ input: join(dir, f) })))
      .png().toFile(join(out, `${v}-${angle}-${letter}.png`));
  }
}
console.log(`${letters.split(',').length * vehicles.length * 2} composites -> ${out}`);

Three-quarter front-left high view. ${PAINT} ${NO_TEXT} ${STUDIO}` });

  const dir = mkdir(join(OUT, 'work', job.id));
  const prompt = `Generate exactly one image with your built-in image generation tool, then copy the generated PNG into the current directory as out.png. Do nothing else and write no code.\n\nImage: ${job.prompt}`;

      resolve(true);
    });
  });
}

const failed: string[] = [];
let next = 0, done = 0;
await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(jobs, todo.length) }, async () => {
  while (next < todo.length) {
    const job = todo[next++]!;
    const ok = (await run(job)) || (await run(job));
    if (!ok) failed.push(job.id);
    console.log(`${++done}/${todo.length} ${ok ? 'ok  ' : 'FAIL'} ${job.group}/${job.id}`);

}));
console.log(failed.length ? `failed: ${failed.join(',')}` : 'all done');

//   node art/tools/contact-sheet.ts <out.jpg> <columns> <tile-width> <square|wide> <image>...
import sharp from 'sharp';

const BACKDROP = { r: 20, g: 27, b: 24 };

// Encode Blender render masters (16-bit RGBA PNG) for embedding (MPES §10, §11).
//   node art/tools/encode-renders.ts measure <masters> <report.json>   AVIF vs WebP quality sweep
//   node art/tools/encode-renders.ts encode <masters> <out-dir> <avif|webp> <quality> [--no-cache]
// Encoded layers are cached under .artifacts/cache/encode/, keyed on the master's bytes, every encoding and trim
// setting and the sharp/libvips versions, so an unchanged master is not re-encoded. --no-cache bypasses it.
// Layers are trimmed to their visible pixels; the manifest records each file's offset in its frame.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, renameSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { basename, join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import sharp, { type OutputInfo } from 'sharp';

type Format = 'avif' | 'webp';
const BACKDROP = { r: 20, g: 27, b: 24 }; // HUD panel colour used to judge visible quality

interface Master { readonly file: string; readonly kind: string; readonly id: string }

function classify(file: string): Master {
  const name = basename(file, '.png');
  if (name.startsWith('card-')) return { file, kind: 'card', id: name };
  if (/-turntable-\d+$/.test(name)) return { file, kind: 'turntable', id: name };
  if (name.endsWith('-hero')) return { file, kind: 'hero', id: name };
  return { file, kind: name.endsWith('-base') ? 'build-base' : 'build-layer', id: name };
}

/** True when a layer has no visible pixel (a part fully hidden behind the hull at this angle). */
async function empty(path: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const stats = await sharp(path).stats();
  return (stats.channels[3]?.max ?? 255) === 0;
}

/**
 * Every setting that shapes the output besides the master and quality. The trim and the encoders read them from here,
 * and the cache key covers them all, so changing any value misses the cache. `revision` covers a change to the code
 * itself that no setting names: raise it with any change to trimmed() or encode().
 */
export const SETTINGS = {
  revision: 1,
  avif: { effort: 6, chromaSubsampling: '4:4:4' }, webp: { alphaQuality: 90, effort: 6, smartSubsample: true },
  apron: 2, trimThreshold: 1, visibleAlpha16: 129, intermediatePngCompression: 0, colourspace: 'srgb' as const,
};

/** Images drawn at their offset in a frame (build layers and bases, turntable frames); cards and heroes show whole. */
const placed = (kind: string) => kind.startsWith('build-') || kind === 'turntable';

async function trimmed(path: string, kind: string): Promise<{ data: Buffer; info: OutputInfo; left: number; top: number; frameWidth: number; frameHeight: number }> {
  const meta = await sharp(path).metadata();
  const { apron, trimThreshold, visibleAlpha16, intermediatePngCompression: compressionLevel, colourspace } = SETTINGS;
  const image = sharp(path).toColourspace(colourspace);
  if (!placed(kind)) {
    // Trim fully transparent margins (threshold on alpha only), keeping the apron; this framing is what is shown.
    const { info } = await image.clone().trim({ background: { r: 0, g: 0, b: 0, alpha: 0 }, threshold: trimThreshold }).toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
    const left = Math.max(0, -(info.trimOffsetLeft ?? 0) - apron), top = Math.max(0, -(info.trimOffsetTop ?? 0) - apron);
    const width = Math.min(meta.width! - left, info.width + 2 * apron), height = Math.min(meta.height! - top, info.height + 2 * apron);
    const out = await image.extract({ left, top, width, height }).png({ compressionLevel }).toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
    return { data: out.data, info: out.info, left, top, frameWidth: meta.width!, frameHeight: meta.height! };
  }
  // A placed image is trimmed to its visible pixels, keeping the apron for soft shadows. Visible means an alpha
  // that survives 8-bit output: 16-bit masters carry faint render noise across the frame, and trimming on any
  // non-zero alpha kept layers near full-frame, so each decode took up to 19 times the pixels (CI run 38136462558).
  const { data, info } = await sharp(path).ensureAlpha().extractChannel(3).raw({ depth: 'ushort' }).toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
  const alpha = new Uint16Array(data.buffer, data.byteOffset, info.width * info.height);
  const visible = meta.depth === 'ushort' ? visibleAlpha16 : 1; // rounds to at least 1/255
  let x0 = info.width, y0 = info.height, x1 = -1, y1 = -1;
  for (let y = 0; y < info.height; y++) for (let x = 0; x < info.width; x++) {
    if (alpha[y * info.width + x]! < visible) continue;
    x0 = Math.min(x0, x); x1 = Math.max(x1, x); y0 = Math.min(y0, y); y1 = Math.max(y1, y);
  }
  if (x1 < 0) { x0 = 0; y0 = 0; x1 = 0; y1 = 0; } // nothing visible: a 1 px image plus the apron
  const left = Math.max(0, x0 - apron), top = Math.max(0, y0 - apron);
  const width = Math.min(meta.width!, x1 + 1 + apron) - left, height = Math.min(meta.height!, y1 + 1 + apron) - top;
  const out = await image.extract({ left, top, width, height }).png({ compressionLevel }).toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
  return { data: out.data, info: out.info, left, top, frameWidth: meta.width!, frameHeight: meta.height! };
}

export const ENCODE_CACHE_DIR = resolve(import.meta.dirname, '../../.artifacts/cache/encode');

async function encode(input: Buffer, format: Format, quality: number): Promise<Buffer> {
  const s = sharp(input);
  return format === 'avif' ? s.avif({ quality, ...SETTINGS.avif }).toBuffer() : s.webp({ quality, ...SETTINGS.webp }).toBuffer();
}

export interface Encoded { readonly data: Buffer; readonly left: number; readonly top: number; readonly frameWidth: number; readonly frameHeight: number; readonly width: number; readonly height: number }

/** sha256 over the master bytes, kind, format, quality, all settings and the sharp + libvips build versions. */
export function cacheKey(master: Buffer, kind: string, format: Format, quality: number): string {
  const h = createHash('sha256');
  h.update(createHash('sha256').update(master).digest());
  h.update(JSON.stringify({ kind, format, quality, settings: SETTINGS, versions: sharp.versions }));
  return h.digest('hex');
}

type Geometry = Omit<Encoded, 'data'>;
const GEOMETRY = ['left', 'top', 'frameWidth', 'frameHeight', 'width', 'height'] as const;

/** sha256 over an entry's geometry and bytes, so damage to either is caught. */
function entrySum(geo: Geometry, data: Buffer): string {
  return createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(GEOMETRY.map(k => geo[k]))).update(data).digest('hex');
}

/** Geometry that can describe a crop of its frame: whole numbers, a non-empty size, inside the frame. */
function sound(geo: Geometry): boolean {
  return GEOMETRY.every(k => Number.isInteger(geo[k]) && geo[k] >= 0) && geo.width > 0 && geo.height > 0
    && geo.left + geo.width <= geo.frameWidth && geo.top + geo.height <= geo.frameHeight;
}

/** Trim and encode one master, reusing a cached result when its key matches. Output is byte-identical either way. */
export async function trimAndEncode(path: string, kind: string, format: Format, quality: number, cache: string | null = ENCODE_CACHE_DIR): Promise<Encoded & { hit: boolean }> {
  const key = cache ? cacheKey(readFileSync(path), kind, format, quality) : '';
  const bin = cache ? join(cache, `${key}.${format}`) : '', json = cache ? join(cache, `${key}.json`) : '';
  if (cache && existsSync(bin) && existsSync(json)) {
    try {
      const entry = JSON.parse(readFileSync(json, 'utf8')) as Geometry & { sha256: string };
      const geo = Object.fromEntries(GEOMETRY.map(k => [k, entry[k]])) as unknown as Geometry, data = readFileSync(bin);
      if (sound(geo) && entrySum(geo, data) === entry.sha256) return { ...geo, data, hit: true };
    } catch { /* unreadable entry: fall through and re-encode */ }
  }
  const t = await trimmed(path, kind);
  const result: Encoded = { data: await encode(t.data, format, quality), left: t.left, top: t.top, frameWidth: t.frameWidth, frameHeight: t.frameHeight, width: t.info.width, height: t.info.height };
  if (cache) {
    mkdirSync(cache, { recursive: true });
    const { data, ...geo } = result;
    // Write to a temporary name and rename, so a parallel or interrupted run never leaves a half-written entry.
    const tmp = `${bin}.${process.pid}.tmp`, tmpJson = `${json}.${process.pid}.tmp`;
    writeFileSync(tmp, data); renameSync(tmp, bin);
    writeFileSync(tmpJson, JSON.stringify({ ...geo, sha256: entrySum(geo, data) })); renameSync(tmpJson, json);
  }
  return { ...result, hit: false };
}

/** PSNR of the encoded image against the master, both flattened onto the HUD backdrop. */
async function psnr(master: Buffer, encoded: Buffer): Promise<number> {
  const flat = async (b: Buffer) => sharp(b).flatten({ background: BACKDROP }).removeAlpha().raw().toBuffer();
  const [a, b] = await Promise.all([flat(master), flat(encoded)]);
  let sum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) { const d = a[i]! - b[i]!; sum += d * d; }
  const mse = sum / a.length;
  return mse === 0 ? 99 : 10 * Math.log10(255 * 255 / mse);
}

async function measure(dir: string, report: string): Promise<void> {
  const masters = readdirSync(dir).filter(f => f.endsWith('.png')).map(classify);
  const settings: [Format, number][] = [['avif', 45], ['avif', 55], ['avif', 65], ['webp', 75], ['webp', 85], ['webp', 92]];
  const rows: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
  for (const [format, quality] of settings) {
    const byKind: Record<string, { files: number; bytes: number; psnr: number }> = {};
    for (const m of masters) {
      const t = await trimmed(join(dir, m.file), m.kind);
      const enc = await encode(t.data, format, quality);
      const k = (byKind[m.kind] ??= { files: 0, bytes: 0, psnr: 0 });
      k.files++; k.bytes += enc.length; k.psnr += await psnr(t.data, enc);
    }
    for (const [kind, k] of Object.entries(byKind)) rows.push({ format, quality, kind, files: k.files, bytes: k.bytes, avgBytes: Math.round(k.bytes / k.files), avgPsnr: +(k.psnr / k.files).toFixed(2) });
  }
  writeFileSync(report, JSON.stringify(rows, null, 2) + '\n');
  console.table(rows);
}

async function encodeAll(dir: string, out: string, format: Format, quality: number, useCache: boolean): Promise<void> {
  mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });
  const renders = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(dir, 'renders.json'), 'utf8')) as { blender: string; seed: number; outputs: { file: string; depth: number; slot?: string }[] };
  const meta = new Map(renders.outputs.map(o => [o.file, o]));
  const masters = readdirSync(dir).filter(f => f.endsWith('.png') && meta.has(f)).sort().map(classify);
  const entries: Record<string, unknown>[] = [], hidden: string[] = [];
  let hits = 0;
  // Encode in parallel; results are sorted by file afterwards so the manifest does not depend on timing.
  let next = 0;
  const work = async () => {
    while (next < masters.length) {
      const m = masters[next++]!;
      if (m.kind === 'build-layer' && await empty(join(dir, m.file))) { hidden.push(m.id); continue; }
      const t = await trimAndEncode(join(dir, m.file), m.kind, format, quality, useCache ? ENCODE_CACHE_DIR : null);
      const data = t.data;
      if (t.hit) hits++;
      const file = basename(m.file, '.png') + '.' + format;
      writeFileSync(join(out, file), data);
      const o = meta.get(m.file)!;
      entries.push({
        file, kind: m.kind, id: m.id, depth: o.depth ?? null, ...(o.slot ? { slot: o.slot } : {}), bytes: data.length, sha256: createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex'),
        frame: { width: t.frameWidth, height: t.frameHeight }, offset: { left: t.left, top: t.top }, size: { width: t.width, height: t.height },
      });
    }
  };
  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 8 }, work));
  entries.sort((x, y) => String(x.file).localeCompare(String(y.file)));
  hidden.sort();
  const total = entries.reduce((n, e) => n + (e.bytes as number), 0);
  writeFileSync(join(out, 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify({ blender: renders.blender, seed: renders.seed, format, quality, totalBytes: total, hidden, entries }, null, 2) + '\n');
  console.log(`${entries.length} files (${hidden.length} hidden layers, ${hits} from cache), ${total} bytes -> ${out}`);
}

// Run as a CLI only when executed directly, so tests can import the helpers above.
if (process.argv[1] && resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2), useCache = !args.includes('--no-cache');
  const [mode, a, b, format, quality] = args.filter(x => x !== '--no-cache');
  if (mode === 'measure' && a && b) await measure(resolve(a), resolve(b));
  else if (mode === 'encode' && a && b && (format === 'avif' || format === 'webp')) await encodeAll(resolve(a), resolve(b), format, Number(quality), useCache);
  else { console.error('usage: measure <masters> <report.json> | encode <masters> <out> <avif|webp> <quality> [--no-cache]'); process.exit(2); }
}
