// Encode cache (art/tools/encode-renders.ts): an unchanged master is not re-encoded, the cached bytes equal a clean
// encode, and changing any setting or the master misses.
import { mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import sharp from 'sharp';
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { SETTINGS, cacheKey, trimAndEncode } from '../../art/tools/encode-renders.ts';

const ROOT = resolve(import.meta.dirname, '..', '..');
const made: string[] = [];
let dir = '', cache = '', master = '';
beforeAll(async () => {
  mkdirSync(join(ROOT, '.artifacts', 'tmp'), { recursive: true });
  dir = mkdtempSync(join(ROOT, '.artifacts', 'tmp', 'sea-encode-'));
  made.push(dir);
  cache = join(dir, 'cache');
  master = join(dir, 'card-test.png');
  // 32x32 transparent frame with a visible 12x12 square, so the trim has something to do.
  const square = await sharp({ create: { width: 12, height: 12, channels: 4, background: { r: 200, g: 80, b: 40, alpha: 1 } } }).png().toBuffer();
  await sharp({ create: { width: 32, height: 32, channels: 4, background: { r: 0, g: 0, b: 0, alpha: 0 } } }).composite([{ input: square, left: 10, top: 9 }]).png().toFile(master);
});
afterAll(() => { for (const dir of made) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 5 }); });

describe('encode cache', () => {
  it('misses once, then hits, and a hit is byte-identical to an uncached encode', async () => {
    const first = await trimAndEncode(master, 'card', 'webp', 80, cache);
    const second = await trimAndEncode(master, 'card', 'webp', 80, cache);
    const clean = await trimAndEncode(master, 'card', 'webp', 80, null);
    expect(first.hit).toBe(false);
    expect(second.hit).toBe(true);
    expect(second.data.equals(clean.data)).toBe(true);
    expect(second.data.equals(first.data)).toBe(true);
    expect([second.left, second.top, second.width, second.height]).toEqual([clean.left, clean.top, clean.width, clean.height]);
  });

  it('misses when quality or format changes', async () => {
    await trimAndEncode(master, 'card', 'webp', 80, cache);
    expect((await trimAndEncode(master, 'card', 'webp', 81, cache)).hit).toBe(false);
    expect((await trimAndEncode(master, 'card', 'avif', 80, cache)).hit).toBe(false);
    expect((await trimAndEncode(master, 'card', 'webp', 81, cache)).hit).toBe(true);
  });

  it('keys on the master bytes and the kind', async () => {
    const bytes = await sharp(master).toBuffer();
    expect(cacheKey(bytes, 'card', 'webp', 80)).toBe(cacheKey(bytes, 'card', 'webp', 80));
    expect(cacheKey(bytes, 'card', 'webp', 80)).not.toBe(cacheKey(bytes, 'hero', 'webp', 80));
    expect(cacheKey(Buffer.concat([bytes, Buffer.from([0])]), 'card', 'webp', 80)).not.toBe(cacheKey(bytes, 'card', 'webp', 80));
  });

  it('re-encodes a corrupted entry instead of trusting it', async () => {
    await trimAndEncode(master, 'card', 'webp', 70, cache);
    for (const f of readdirSync(cache).filter(n => n.endsWith('.webp'))) writeFileSync(join(cache, f), Buffer.from('corrupt'));
    const again = await trimAndEncode(master, 'card', 'webp', 70, cache);
    expect(again.hit).toBe(false);
    expect(again.data.equals((await trimAndEncode(master, 'card', 'webp', 70, null)).data)).toBe(true);
  });

  // Codex G3 review finding 9: the checksum covered the image only, so damaged offsets were a hit.
  it('re-encodes an entry whose geometry was changed, even to valid JSON', async () => {
    await trimAndEncode(master, 'card', 'webp', 60, cache);
    for (const f of readdirSync(cache).filter(n => n.endsWith('.json'))) {
      const entry = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(cache, f), 'utf8')) as Record<string, unknown>;
      writeFileSync(join(cache, f), JSON.stringify({ ...entry, left: Number(entry['left']) + 100 }));
    }
    const again = await trimAndEncode(master, 'card', 'webp', 60, cache);
    expect(again.hit).toBe(false);
    expect(again.left).toBe((await trimAndEncode(master, 'card', 'webp', 60, null)).left);
  });

  // Codex G3 review finding 8: the trim used its own literals, so changing the apron in SETTINGS changed nothing.
  it('trims with the apron in SETTINGS, which is part of the key', async () => {
    const bytes = await sharp(master).toBuffer(), before = await trimAndEncode(master, 'card', 'webp', 50, null);
    const key = cacheKey(bytes, 'card', 'webp', 50), apron = SETTINGS.apron;
    try {
      SETTINGS.apron = apron + 2;
      expect(cacheKey(bytes, 'card', 'webp', 50)).not.toBe(key);
      const wider = await trimAndEncode(master, 'card', 'webp', 50, null);
      expect([wider.left, wider.top, wider.width, wider.height]).toEqual([before.left - 2, before.top - 2, before.width + 4, before.height + 4]);
    } finally { SETTINGS.apron = apron; }
  });

  it('keys on a revision of the trim and encode code, for changes no setting names', () => {
    expect(Number.isInteger(SETTINGS.revision)).toBe(true);
  });
});

// MPES §10.2 (owner FIX 2026-10-12): the 3D showcase frames the vehicle as fitted, however fully kitted out, every part
// in view at every turn and at every height the player can drag to, and zooms in and out within set limits.
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { Box3, Vector3 } from 'three';
import { distanceAt, extentAt, FIT_MARGIN, fitDistance, fitTable, viewDirection, ZOOM_IN_LIMIT, ZOOM_OUT_LIMIT, zoomed } from '../../source/showcase/frame.ts';

const FOV = 30, POLARS = [0.6, 1.25, 1.45];
const boxes = {
  long: new Box3(new Vector3(-1.4, 0, -4), new Vector3(1.4, 2.6, 4)),
  tall: new Box3(new Vector3(-1.2, 0, -2), new Vector3(1.2, 5.5, 2)),
  offCentre: new Box3(new Vector3(0.5, 0.2, -1), new Vector3(3.5, 3, 6.5)),
};

describe('showcase framing (MPES §10.2)', () => {
  for (const [name, box] of Object.entries(boxes)) for (const aspect of [16 / 9, 1, 9 / 16]) {
    it(`fits the ${name} kit at every turn and height, aspect ${aspect.toFixed(2)}`, () => {
      const target = box.getCenter(new Vector3());
      const distance = fitDistance(box, target, POLARS, FOV, aspect);
      let worst = 0;
      for (const polar of POLARS) for (let i = 0; i < 360; i += 5) {
        const extent = extentAt(box, target, viewDirection(polar, (i * Math.PI) / 180), distance, FOV, aspect);
        expect(extent, `polar ${polar}, azimuth ${i}`).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
        worst = Math.max(worst, extent);
      }
      // Tight, not merely safe: the worst view uses the frame up to the margin.
      expect(worst).toBeGreaterThan(FIT_MARGIN - 0.03);
    });
  }

  for (const [name, box] of Object.entries(boxes)) it(`keeps the ${name} kit in view at every height the player drags to`, () => {
    const target = box.getCenter(new Vector3());
    const table = fitTable(box, target, 0.6, 1.45, FOV, 16 / 9);
    for (let polar = 0.6; polar <= 1.45 + 1e-9; polar += 0.025) for (let i = 0; i < 360; i += 5) {
      const extent = extentAt(box, target, viewDirection(polar, (i * Math.PI) / 180), distanceAt(table, polar), FOV, 16 / 9);
      expect(extent, `polar ${polar.toFixed(3)}, azimuth ${i}`).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
    }
    expect(distanceAt(table, 0.1)).toBe(table.distances[0]);
    expect(distanceAt(table, 3)).toBe(table.distances.at(-1));
  });

  it('zooms in and out by steps, within its limits', () => {
    expect(zoomed(1, 1)).toBeLessThan(1);
    expect(zoomed(1, -1)).toBeGreaterThan(1);
    let zoom = 1;
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) zoom = zoomed(zoom, 1);
    expect(zoom).toBe(ZOOM_IN_LIMIT);
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) zoom = zoomed(zoom, -1);
    expect(zoom).toBe(ZOOM_OUT_LIMIT);
    expect(ZOOM_IN_LIMIT).toBeLessThan(1);
    expect(ZOOM_OUT_LIMIT).toBeGreaterThan(1);
  });
});

Paths: `tests/unit/glb.test.ts`. SHA-256 `5e1c561824daa789642c8b5491d0af6b1d801daa1fd17e0d8613bda6c6026c3d`, 3523 bytes.

```ts
// MPES §10, §14: the embedded model holds all six vehicles, but the game parses only the team's vehicle, so the
// 3D stage is ready within budget. vehicleGlb narrows the GLB's scene to that vehicle's node; the loader then
// fetches only what that node references.
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { vehicleGlb } from '../../source/showcase/glb.ts';
import { VEHICLE } from '../../source/showcase/renders.ts';

interface Gltf { scene?: number; scenes: { nodes: number[] }[]; nodes: { name?: string; children?: number[] }[] }

function glb(json: object, bin: Uint8Array): ArrayBuffer {
  const text = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(json));
  const jsonLen = Math.ceil(text.length / 4) * 4, binLen = Math.ceil(bin.length / 4) * 4;
  const out = new Uint8Array(12 + 8 + jsonLen + 8 + binLen);
  const view = new DataView(out.buffer);
  view.setUint32(0, 0x46546c67, true); view.setUint32(4, 2, true); view.setUint32(8, out.length, true);
  view.setUint32(12, jsonLen, true); view.setUint32(16, 0x4e4f534a, true);
  out.fill(0x20, 20, 20 + jsonLen); out.set(text, 20);
  view.setUint32(20 + jsonLen, binLen, true); view.setUint32(24 + jsonLen, 0x004e4942, true);
  out.set(bin, 28 + jsonLen);
  return out.buffer;
}

function parse(buffer: ArrayBuffer): { json: Gltf; bin: Uint8Array; length: number } {
  const view = new DataView(buffer);
  const jsonLen = view.getUint32(12, true);
  const json = JSON.parse(new TextDecoder().decode(new Uint8Array(buffer, 20, jsonLen))) as Gltf;
  const binLen = view.getUint32(20 + jsonLen, true);
  return { json, bin: new Uint8Array(buffer, 28 + jsonLen, binLen), length: view.getUint32(8, true) };
}

describe('vehicleGlb (MPES §10, §14)', () => {
  const json = { asset: { version: '2.0' }, scene: 0, scenes: [{ nodes: [0, 1] }], nodes: [{ name: 'combat', children: [2] }, { name: 'recce' }, { name: 'base' }] };
  const bin = new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]);

  it("keeps only the vehicle's root node in the scene, and the binary chunk unchanged", () => {
    const out = parse(vehicleGlb(glb(json, bin), 'recce')!);
    expect(out.json.scenes).toEqual([{ nodes: [1] }]);
    expect(out.json.scene).toBe(0);
    expect(out.json.nodes).toEqual(json.nodes);
    expect([...out.bin]).toEqual([...bin]);
  });

  it('writes a valid GLB: 4-byte aligned chunks and the total length in the header', () => {
    const buffer = vehicleGlb(glb(json, bin), 'combat')!;
    const out = parse(buffer);
    expect(out.length).toBe(buffer.byteLength);
    expect(new DataView(buffer).getUint32(12, true) % 4).toBe(0);
    expect(out.json.scenes).toEqual([{ nodes: [0] }]);
  });

  it('returns null for a vehicle that is not a root node, or for data that is not a GLB', () => {
    expect(vehicleGlb(glb(json, bin), 'base')).toBeNull();
    expect(vehicleGlb(glb(json, bin), 'mine-clearing')).toBeNull();
    expect(vehicleGlb(new Uint8Array(32).buffer, 'combat')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('finds every vehicle in the committed model', () => {
    const manifest = JSON.parse(readFileSync('content/models/manifest.json', 'utf8')) as { file: string };
    const file = readFileSync(`content/models/${manifest.file}`);
    const buffer = file.buffer.slice(file.byteOffset, file.byteOffset + file.byteLength);
    for (const stem of Object.values(VEHICLE)) {
      const out = parse(vehicleGlb(buffer, stem)!);
      expect(out.json.scenes[0]!.nodes.map(i => out.json.nodes[i]!.name)).toEqual([stem]);
    }
  });
});
```

// RQ-03, RQ-06, RQ-07, RQ-08, RQ-10, RQ-11: instructor commands and their rejections.
import fc from 'fast-check';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { DomainError } from '../../source/domain/errors.ts';
import * as I from '../../source/domain/instructor.ts';
import { instructorForSave, validateInstructor } from '../../source/domain/saves.ts';
import type { RevealMode } from '../../source/domain/session.ts';
import { specDealVectors } from './spec.ts';

const SEED = '00000000000000000000000000000000';
const VECTOR = specDealVectors()[SEED]!;
const code = (fn: () => unknown) => { try { fn(); } catch (e) { return e instanceof DomainError ? e.code : String(e); } return 'no error'; };
let t = 1_900_000_000_000;
const now = (step = 1000) => (t += step);

function session(teams = 3, revealMode: RevealMode = 'JIT', timingMode: 'TIMED' | 'UNTIMED' = 'TIMED'): I.InstructorState {
  let s = I.generateSession(I.instructorShell('en'), { teamCount: teams, revealMode, timingMode, bidSeconds: 30, token: '0123456789ABCDEF', seed: SEED });
  s = I.startPractice(s);
  for (const a of ['reveal', 'open', 'accept', 'close'] as const) s = I.practiceStep(s, a);
  s = I.openPlanning(s);
  for (let id = 1; id <= teams; id++) s = I.selectMission(s, id, 'TROOP');
  return I.startAuction(s);
}
const bidFor = (s: I.InstructorState, team: number) => I.acceptBid(s, team, I.nextOffer(s)!, now());
const valid = (s: I.InstructorState) => expect(validateInstructor(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(instructorForSave(s))))).toEqual(instructorForSave(s));

describe('setup, practice and planning (RQ-03, RQ-11)', () => {
  it('generates a session whose market is the Appendix B deal', () => {
    const s = I.generateSession(I.instructorShell(), { teamCount: 4, revealMode: 'MANUAL', timingMode: 'UNTIMED', bidSeconds: 45, token: 'ABCDEF0123456789', seed: SEED });
    expect(s.sessionCode).toBe('SEA3-T4-ABCDEF0123456789');
    expect(s.market.map(r => r.map(c => c.id))).toEqual(VECTOR);
    expect(s.teams).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(s.revealed).toBe(false);
    valid(s);
  });
  it('rejects bad options', () => {
    const shell = I.instructorShell();
    const base = { teamCount: 4, revealMode: 'JIT', timingMode: 'TIMED', bidSeconds: 30, token: '0123456789ABCDEF', seed: SEED } as const;
    expect(code(() => I.generateSession(shell, { ...base, teamCount: 11 }))).toBe('team');
    expect(code(() => I.generateSession(shell, { ...base, bidSeconds: 9 }))).toBe('time');
    expect(code(() => I.generateSession(shell, { ...base, token: 'xyz' }))).toBe('code');

describe('outcomes, corrections and void (RQ-06, RQ-08)', () => {
  it('commits a sale to the leader and requires a reason for a correction', () => {
    let s = bidFor(I.openBidding(session(), now()), 1);
    expect(code(() => I.commitSale(s, 2, 40_000_000))).toBe('reason');
    expect(code(() => I.commitSale(s, 1, 42_000_000, 'typo'))).toBe('money');
    const corrected = I.commitSale(s, 2, 50_000_000, 'Team 2 bid was missed');
    expect(corrected.ledger.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'SALE', team: 2, price: 50_000_000, reason: 'Team 2 bid was missed' });
    s = I.commitSale(s, 1, 40_000_000);
    expect(s.ledger.at(-1)).toEqual({ seq: 1, kind: 'SALE', round: 1, lot: 1, card: 'CAP-G', team: 1, price: 40_000_000 });
    expect(s.teams[0]!.cost).toBe(40_000_000);
    expect(s.teams[0]!.totals.CAP).toBe(4);
    expect(code(() => I.commitUnsold(s))).toBe('phase');
    valid(s);
  });
  it('allows unsold with a leader, and void then requires a replacement before advancing', () => {
    let s = bidFor(I.openBidding(session(), now()), 3);
    s = I.commitUnsold(s);
    expect(s.leader).toBeNull();
    s = I.voidCurrent(s, 'Team 3 did bid');
    expect(code(() => I.advance(s))).toBe('phase');
    expect(code(() => I.voidCurrent(s, 'again'))).toBe('phase');
    s = I.commitSale(bidFor(I.openBidding(s, now()), 3), 3, 40_000_000);

    expect(s.teams[2]!.purchases).toEqual([]);
    expect(s.ledger.map(e => e.kind)).toEqual(['UNSOLD', 'VOID', 'SALE', 'VOID']);
    expect(s.ledger.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ ref: 3, team: 3, price: 40_000_000 });
    s = I.commitUnsold(I.openBidding(s, now()));
    s = I.advance(s);
    expect([s.round, s.lot]).toEqual([0, 1]);
    valid(s);
  });
  it('enforces two wins per team per round, including corrected sales', () => {
    let s = session();
    for (let lot = 0; lot < 2; lot++) s = I.advance(I.commitSale(bidFor(I.openBidding(s, now()), 1), 1, I.currentCard(s).start));
    s = I.openBidding(s, now());
    expect(code(() => bidFor(s, 1))).toBe('limit');
    s = bidFor(s, 2);
    expect(code(() => I.commitSale(s, 1, s.currentBid!, 'correction'))).toBe('limit');
  });
  it('stops repeated corrections before the 210-entry ledger is exhausted', () => {
    let s = session();
    let cycles = 0;
    for (;;) {
      s = I.commitSale(bidFor(I.openBidding(s, now()), 1), 1, 40_000_000);
      const attempt = code(() => I.voidCurrent(s, 'retry'));
      if (attempt !== 'no error') { expect(attempt).toBe('ledger-limit'); break; }
      s = I.voidCurrent(s, 'retry');
      cycles++;
    }
    expect(s.ledger.length + 69).toBeLessThanOrEqual(210);
    expect(cycles).toBe(70);
    valid(s);
  });
});

// Owner request 2026-10-11 (MPES §6.5): when no team may win more this round, one command closes the rest unsold.
describe('closing a round no team can win in', () => {
  /** Two wins each for teams 1..n in the current round, from the current lot on. */
  function fill(s: I.InstructorState, teams: number): I.InstructorState {
    for (let id = 1; id <= teams; id++) {
      for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) s = I.advance(I.commitSale(bidFor(I.openBidding(s, now()), id), id, I.currentCard(s).start));
    }
    return s;
  }
  it('is refused while any team may still win, and offered from the sale that used the last win', () => {
    let s = fill(session(2), 1);
    s = I.advance(I.commitSale(bidFor(I.openBidding(s, now()), 2), 2, I.currentCard(s).start));
    expect(I.lotsNobodyCanWin(s)).toBe(0);
    expect(code(() => I.closeRound(s))).toBe('phase');
    s = I.commitSale(bidFor(I.openBidding(s, now()), 2), 2, I.currentCard(s).start);
    expect([s.round, s.lot]).toEqual([0, 3]);
    expect(I.lotsNobodyCanWin(s)).toBe(6);
    const before = s.ledger.length;
    const closed = I.closeRound(s);
    expect(closed.ledger.slice(before).map(e => [e.kind, e.lot])).toEqual([5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10].map(lot => ['UNSOLD', lot]));
    expect([closed.round, closed.lot]).toEqual([1, 0]);
    valid(closed);
    expect(I.lotsNobodyCanWin(I.advance(s))).toBe(6);
  });
  it('is not offered when the sale that used the last win was on the last lot', () => {
    let s = session(2);
    for (let lot = 0; lot < 6; lot++) s = I.advance(I.commitUnsold(I.openBidding(s, now())));
    s = fill(s, 1);
    s = I.advance(I.commitSale(bidFor(I.openBidding(s, now()), 2), 2, I.currentCard(s).start));
    s = I.commitSale(bidFor(I.openBidding(s, now()), 2), 2, I.currentCard(s).start);
    expect([s.round, s.lot]).toEqual([0, 9]);
    expect(I.lotsNobodyCanWin(s)).toBe(0);
    expect(code(() => I.closeRound(s))).toBe('phase');
  });
  it('records every remaining lot of the round unsold and opens the next round, in each reveal mode', () => {
    for (const mode of ['ROUND', 'JIT', 'MANUAL'] as const) {
      let s = fill(session(3, mode), 3);
      expect([s.round, s.lot]).toEqual([0, 6]);
      expect(I.lotsNobodyCanWin(s)).toBe(4);
      const gone = I.cardsNobodyCanWin(s);
      expect(gone).toEqual(s.market[0]!.slice(6));
      const before = s.ledger.length;
      s = I.closeRound(s);
      expect(s.ledger.slice(before).map(e => [e.kind, e.round, e.lot])).toEqual([7, 8, 9, 10].map(lot => ['UNSOLD', 1, lot]));
      // Listed again in the next round as out of the game: the cards each lot showed, never any later round's.
      expect(I.unsoldIn(s, 0)).toEqual(gone);
      expect(I.cardsNobodyCanWin(s)).toEqual([]);
      expect(s.ledger.map(e => e.seq)).toEqual(s.ledger.map((_, i) => i + 1));
      expect([s.round, s.lot, s.open, s.leader]).toEqual([1, 0, false, null]);
      expect(s.revealed).toBe(mode !== 'MANUAL');
      valid(s);
    }
  });
  it('works while bidding is open or paused, since no team can lead', () => {
    let s = I.openBidding(fill(session(2), 2), now());
    expect(I.lotsNobodyCanWin(s)).toBe(6);
    expect([I.closeRound(s).round, I.closeRound(s).lot]).toEqual([1, 0]);
    s = I.closeRound(I.pause(s, now()));
    expect([s.round, s.lot, s.pausedRemaining, s.deadline]).toEqual([1, 0, null, null]);
    valid(s);
  });
  it('stays on the last lot of round 7 so moving to build remains a deliberate step', () => {
    let s = session(2);
    for (let r = 0; r < 6; r++) s = I.closeRound(fill(s, 2));
    expect([s.round, s.lot]).toEqual([6, 0]);
    s = I.closeRound(fill(s, 2));
    expect([s.phase, s.round, s.lot]).toEqual(['auction', 6, 9]);
    expect(I.currentOutcome(s)?.kind).toBe('UNSOLD');
    expect(I.lotsNobodyCanWin(s)).toBe(0);
    s = I.advance(s);
    expect(s.phase).toBe('build');
    expect(s.ledger).toHaveLength(70);
    valid(s);
  });
});

function playToBuild(s: I.InstructorState): I.InstructorState {
  while (s.phase === 'auction') {
    if (!I.currentOutcome(s)) {
      s = I.openBidding(s, now());
      const team = s.teams.find(x => x.purchasesByRound[s.round]! < 2 && (s.lot + x.id) % 3 === 0);
      if (team) { const leading = bidFor(s, team.id); s = I.commitSale(leading, team.id, leading.currentBid!); } else s = I.commitUnsold(s);
    }
    s = I.advance(s);
  }
  return s;
}

    s = I.closeRoom(I.closeSubmissions(s));

    valid(s);

});

    const action = fc.oneof(

      fc.constant({ kind: 'pause' as const }), fc.constant({ kind: 'resume' as const }), fc.constant({ kind: 'extend' as const }),
      fc.record({ kind: fc.constant('bid' as const), team: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 4 }) }),
      fc.record({ kind: fc.constant('sale' as const), team: fc.integer({ min: 1, max: 4 }), steps: fc.integer({ min: 0, max: 3 }) }),
      fc.record({ kind: fc.constant('void' as const) }), fc.constant({ kind: 'close-round' as const }),
    );
    fc.assert(fc.property(fc.array(action, { maxLength: 120 }), fc.constantFrom<RevealMode>('ROUND', 'JIT', 'MANUAL'), (actions, mode) => {

      for (const a of actions) {
        const before = s;

          switch (a.kind) {
            case 'open': s = I.openBidding(s.revealed ? s : I.reveal(s), now()); break;
            case 'bid': s = bidFor(s, a.team); break;
            case 'sale': s = I.commitSale(s, a.team, I.currentCard(s).start + a.steps * 5_000_000, 'adjusted'); break;
            case 'unsold': s = I.commitUnsold(s); break;
            case 'void': s = I.voidCurrent(s, 'property'); break;
            case 'advance': s = I.advance(s); break;
            case 'close-round': s = I.closeRound(s); break;
            case 'pause': s = I.pause(s, now()); break;
            case 'resume': s = I.resume(s, now()); break;
            case 'extend': s = I.extend(s, now()); break;
          }
        } catch (e) {
          expect(e).toBeInstanceOf(DomainError);
          expect(s).toBe(before);
        }
        valid(s);
      }
    }), { numRuns: 60, seed: 20261009 });
  });
});

// G2 item 6 (Omni 5.1.1 §6.2, AGENTS.md rule 18): docs/MPES.md alone rebuilds the project, without code. It has no
// code block, names every tracked source, test, script, configuration and document file, every npm script and every
// pinned package at its exact version, and states the Content-Security-Policy the build writes.
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

const MPES = readFileSync('docs/MPES.md', 'utf8');
const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')) as {
  scripts: Record<string, string>; dependencies: Record<string, string>; devDependencies: Record<string, string>; overrides: Record<string, string>;
};

describe('docs/MPES.md', () => {
  it('holds no code block', () => {
    const fences = MPES.split('\n').map((line, i) => [i + 1, line] as const).filter(([, line]) => /^\s*(```|~~~)/.test(line));
    expect(fences.map(([n]) => n)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('names every tracked file a rebuild writes by hand', () => {
    const tracked = execFileSync('git', ['ls-files', '-z'], { encoding: 'utf8', maxBuffer: 1 << 26 }).split('\0').filter(Boolean);
    // Generated or bulk files are named by their folder and the command that makes them: renders, the model, visual
    // baselines, legacy fixtures (copied from the previous application) and recycled files. Omni is not tracked.
    const byFolder = /^(content\/renders\/.+\.avif|content\/models\/showcase\.glb|tests\/e2e\/visual\.spec\.ts-snapshots\/|tests\/fixtures\/legacy\/|_archive\/)/;
    const missing = tracked.filter(path => !byFolder.test(path) && !MPES.includes(`\`${path}\``));
    expect(missing).toEqual([]);
    for (const folder of ['content/renders/', 'content/models/showcase.glb', 'tests/e2e/visual.spec.ts-snapshots/', 'tests/fixtures/legacy/']) {
      expect(MPES, folder).toContain(`\`${folder}`);
    }
  });

  it('names every npm script', () => {
    for (const name of Object.keys(pkg.scripts)) expect(MPES, name).toContain(`\`npm run ${name}\``);
  });

  it('pins every package at its exact version', () => {
    const pins = { ...pkg.dependencies, ...pkg.devDependencies, ...pkg.overrides };
    const lines = MPES.split('\n');
    for (const [name, version] of Object.entries(pins)) {
      expect(lines.some(line => line.includes(`\`${name}\``) && line.includes(version)), `${name} ${version}`).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  it('states the Content-Security-Policy directives the build writes', () => {
    const build = readFileSync('build/render.ts', 'utf8');
    const written = [...build.matchAll(/^\s*[`"]([a-z-]+) /gm)].map(m => m[1]!).sort();
    const section = MPES.split('### 13.1')[1]!.split('\n### ')[0]!;
    const stated = [...section.matchAll(/^\| `([a-z-]+)` \|/gm)].map(m => m[1]!).sort();
    expect(written.length).toBeGreaterThan(10);
    expect(stated).toEqual(written);
  });

  it('plans G3 to G8 with their versions', () => {
    const plan = MPES.split('## 17.')[1]!.split('\n## ')[0]!;
    for (const [goal, version] of [['G3', '0.6.0.0'], ['G4', '0.7.0.0'], ['G5', '0.8.0.0'], ['G6', '0.9.0.0'], ['G7', '0.9.1.0'], ['G8', '1.0.0.0']] as const) {
      expect(plan, goal).toMatch(new RegExp(`\\*\\*${goal}\\b[^|]*\\|[^\\n]*${version.replace(/\./g, '\\.')}`));
    }
  });
});

// MPES §10.3: the 3D showcase never takes more than half the machine. A frame that drew is timed by the gap
// to the next animation frame; the stage then waits at least twice that long before drawing again.
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { FRAME_MS, FramePacer, TIERS, nextTier, startTier } from '../../source/showcase/pace.ts';

/** Runs `ms` of animation frames where each drawn frame costs `cost` ms; returns the draw times. */
function run(pacer: FramePacer, start: number, ms: number, cost: number, vsync = 1000 / 60): number[] {
  const draws: number[] = [];
  for (let now = start; now < start + ms;) {
    if (pacer.due(now)) { pacer.drew(now); draws.push(now); now += Math.max(vsync, cost); } else now += vsync;
  }
  return draws;
}

describe('frame pacer (MPES §10.3)', () => {
  it('draws at 30 fps on a 60 Hz display when frames are cheap', () => {
    const draws = run(new FramePacer(), 0, 1000, 2);
    expect(draws.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(29);
    expect(draws.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(31);
  });

  it('keeps 30 fps on a 144 Hz display', () => {
    const draws = run(new FramePacer(), 0, 1000, 2, 1000 / 144);
    expect(draws.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(28);
    expect(draws.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(31);
  });

  it('spends at most half the time drawing when frames are slow (software rendering)', () => {
    const pacer = new FramePacer();
    const cost = 400, draws = run(pacer, 0, 20_000, cost);
    expect(draws.length * cost).toBeLessThanOrEqual(20_000 / 2 + cost * 2);
    expect(draws.length).toBeGreaterThan(5); // it still turns
  });

  it('never waits longer than a second between frames', () => {
    const pacer = new FramePacer(), draws = run(pacer, 0, 30_000, 3000);
    for (let i = 1; i < draws.length; i++) expect(draws[i]! - draws[i - 1]!).toBeLessThanOrEqual(3000 + 1000 + 17);
    expect(pacer.interval).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1000);
  });

  it('returns to 30 fps once frames are cheap again', () => {
    const pacer = new FramePacer();
    run(pacer, 0, 5000, 300);
    expect(pacer.interval).toBeGreaterThan(FRAME_MS * 2);
    run(pacer, 5000, 3000, 2);
    expect(pacer.interval).toBeLessThan(FRAME_MS + 1);
  });

  it('does not count time spent stopped as drawing time', () => {
    const pacer = new FramePacer();
    expect(pacer.due(0)).toBe(true);
    pacer.drew(0);
    pacer.pause();
    expect(pacer.due(60_000)).toBe(true);
    expect(pacer.interval).toBeLessThan(FRAME_MS + 1);
  });

  // G3 (CI run 38571533524): a purchase drawn right after a paced turning draw waited for it on a slow renderer.
  it('holds paced draws after input from the player, so an answer to it never queues behind one', () => {
    const pacer = new FramePacer();
    expect(pacer.due(0)).toBe(true);
    pacer.drew(0);
    pacer.hold(1000);
    expect(pacer.due(500)).toBe(false);
    expect(pacer.due(999)).toBe(false);
    expect(pacer.due(1000)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('reports the cheapest of the last eight draws, and nothing before eight', () => {
    const pacer = new FramePacer();
    run(pacer, 0, 7 * 50, 50, 50);
    expect(pacer.floor).toBeNaN();
    run(pacer, 350, 20 * 50, 50, 50);
    expect(pacer.floor).toBe(50);
    pacer.forget();
    expect(pacer.floor).toBeNaN();
  });
});

describe('adaptive tiers (MPES §10.3)', () => {
  it('stays at full resolution while a draw fits in a 30 fps frame', () => {
    expect(nextTier(0, 1000 / 60)).toBe(0);
    expect(nextTier(0, FRAME_MS)).toBe(0);
    expect(nextTier(0, Number.NaN)).toBe(0);
  });

  it('steps down one tier when even the cheapest recent draw is too slow, never below the last', () => {
    expect(nextTier(0, 60)).toBe(1);
    expect(nextTier(1, 60)).toBe(2);
    expect(nextTier(TIERS.length - 1, 600)).toBe(TIERS.length - 1);
  });

  it('never steps back up', () => {
    expect(nextTier(2, 1)).toBe(2);
  });
});

// G3 (CI run 38571533524): on a software renderer multisampling made a draw 3.6 times dearer, and each fresh page began
// at full resolution, so its first purchases waited on draws of about 170 ms before the tiers could step down.
describe('starting tier (MPES §10.3)', () => {
  it('runs from dearest to cheapest, and multisampling goes before the last step of resolution', () => {
    for (let i = 1; i < TIERS.length; i++) {
      const [a, b] = [TIERS[i - 1]!, TIERS[i]!];
      expect(b.scale <= a.scale && (b.samples <= a.samples)).toBe(true);
      expect(b.scale < a.scale || b.samples < a.samples).toBe(true);
    }
    expect(TIERS[0]).toEqual({ scale: 1, samples: 4 });
    expect(TIERS.at(-1)!.samples).toBe(0);
  });

  it('keeps full quality where one draw fits a 30 fps frame, timing only that one', () => {
    const timed: number[] = [];
    expect(startTier(tier => { timed.push(tier); return 4; })).toBe(0);
    expect(timed).toEqual([0]);
  });

  it('starts at the first tier whose draw fits', () => {
    const costs = [50, 30, 12, 8];
    expect(startTier(tier => costs[tier]!)).toBe(1);
  });

  it('skips a tier that only lowers resolution when the area alone cannot bring the draw within the frame', () => {
    const costs = [250, 200, 65, 45], timed: number[] = [];
    expect(startTier(tier => { timed.push(tier); return costs[tier]!; })).toBe(TIERS.length - 1);
    expect(timed).not.toContain(1);
    expect(timed).toContain(2);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { MIN_SAMPLES, p95 } from '../perf/measure.ts';

describe('perf measurement protocol (MPES §14)', () => {
  it('takes the nearest-rank p95', () => {
    const values = Array.from({ length: 40 }, (_, i) => i + 1);
    expect(p95(values)).toBe(38);
    expect(p95(values.slice(0, 30).reverse())).toBe(29);
    expect(p95(Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, i) => i + 1))).toBe(95);

    expect(p95([5, 7], 2)).toBe(7);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { BROWSERS, KPIS, METRICS, PROFILES, buildReport, renderMarkdown, statusOf, type RunFile } from '../perf-ref/report.ts';

const ID = 'run-1';
const at = { runId: ID, stamp: 's', commit: 'c', dirty: false };
/** A value within budget for every budgeted metric. */
const passing = Object.fromEntries(METRICS.filter(m => m.budget !== null).map(m => [m.id, 0]));

const run = (browser: string, profile: string, values: Record<string, number | null>, state: RunFile['state'] = 'OK', runId = ID): RunFile => ({
  meta: { runId, browser, browserVersion: '1', profile, viewport: { width: 1366, height: 768, scale: 1 }, cpuThrottle: 4, gpu: { vendor: 'Intel', renderer: 'ANGLE (Intel UHD Graphics 770)' }, idleSeconds: 60 },
  state, values, notes: {},
});
/** All six runs of a complete perf:ref, every budgeted metric within budget, with `change` applied to the first. */
const complete = (change: Record<string, number | null> = {}): RunFile[] =>
  BROWSERS.flatMap(browser => PROFILES.map(profile => run(browser, profile.id, { ...passing })))
    .map((r, i) => (i === 0 ? { ...r, values: { ...r.values, ...change } } : r));

describe('perf:ref report', () => {
  it('has one row per KPI of MPES §1.4, in order', () => {
    expect(KPIS).toHaveLength(12);
    expect(buildReport(complete(), at).kpis.map(r => r.kpi)).toEqual([...KPIS]);
  });

  it('has unique metric ids, each under a known KPI', () => {
    expect(new Set(METRICS.map(m => m.id)).size).toBe(METRICS.length);
    for (const metric of METRICS) expect(KPIS).toContain(metric.kpi);
  });

  it('reads a value against its budget, and a missing one as NOT_RUN', () => {
    const chooser = METRICS.find(m => m.id === 'chooserMs')!;
    expect(statusOf(chooser, 2000)).toBe('PASS');
    expect(statusOf(chooser, 2001)).toBe('FAIL');
    expect(statusOf(chooser, null)).toBe('NOT_RUN');
    expect(statusOf(chooser, undefined)).toBe('NOT_RUN');
  });

  it('takes the worst value over runs and fails the KPI when one metric is over budget', () => {
    const report = buildReport(complete({ chooserMs: 2500 }), at);
    const browser = report.kpis.find(r => r.kpi === 'Browser performance')!;
    const chooser = browser.metrics.find(m => m.id === 'chooserMs')!;
    expect(chooser.worst).toBe(2500);
    expect(chooser.status).toBe('FAIL');
    expect(browser.status).toBe('FAIL');
    expect(report.state).toBe('BASELINE');
  });

  it('is INCOMPLETE, and keeps no numbers from a run that failed its GPU check', () => {
    const report = buildReport([run('chromium', PROFILES[0].id, { chooserMs: 100 }, 'GPU_CHECK_FAILED')], at);
    expect(report.state).toBe('INCOMPLETE');
    expect(report.problems.join(' ')).toContain('GPU_CHECK_FAILED');
    expect(report.kpis.find(r => r.kpi === 'Browser performance')!.metrics.every(m => m.worst === null)).toBe(true);
    expect(buildReport([], at).state).toBe('INCOMPLETE');
  });

  // Codex G3 review finding 2: one Chromium profile holding only chooserMs was reported as a BASELINE.
  it('is INCOMPLETE unless both browsers ran every screen profile', () => {
    const five = complete().slice(1);
    const report = buildReport(five, at);
    expect(report.state).toBe('INCOMPLETE');
    expect(report.problems.join(' ')).toContain(`missing run: ${BROWSERS[0]} ${PROFILES[0].id}`);
    expect(buildReport([run('chromium', PROFILES[0].id, { chooserMs: 100 })], at).state).toBe('INCOMPLETE');
  });

  it('is INCOMPLETE when a budgeted metric is missing without a reason, and accepts one with a reason', () => {
    const missing = complete({ modelUpdateP95Ms: null });
    const report = buildReport(missing, at);
    expect(report.state).toBe('INCOMPLETE');
    expect(report.problems.join(' ')).toContain('modelUpdateP95Ms');
    missing[0]!.notes['modelUpdateP95Ms'] = 'why';
    expect(buildReport(missing, at).state).toBe('BASELINE');
  });

  it('is INCOMPLETE when a run file belongs to another run (a reused folder)', () => {
    const runs = complete();
    runs.push(run('chromium', PROFILES[0].id, { ...passing }, 'OK', 'run-0'));
    const report = buildReport(runs, at);
    expect(report.state).toBe('INCOMPLETE');
    expect(report.problems.join(' ')).toContain('run-0');
  });

  it('counts only this run\'s files, so an old file cannot change a number', () => {
    const runs = complete();
    runs.push(run('chromium', PROFILES[0].id, { ...passing, chooserMs: 9999 }, 'OK', 'run-0'));
    const chooser = buildReport(runs, at).kpis.flatMap(r => r.metrics).find(m => m.id === 'chooserMs')!;
    expect(chooser.worst).toBe(0);
  });

  it('renders every KPI and metric in the Markdown', () => {
    const text = renderMarkdown(buildReport(complete(), at));
    for (const kpi of KPIS) expect(text).toContain(kpi);
    for (const metric of METRICS) expect(text).toContain(metric.label);
  });
});

// G2 item 2: the licence and notices keep their files verbatim but display as reflowed paragraphs, so the
// dialog wraps each line once, at its own width, instead of at the file's hard breaks as well.
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { reflow } from '../../source/ui/reflow.ts';

describe('reflow for display (About dialog)', () => {
  it('joins hard-wrapped lines and keeps blank-line paragraph breaks', () => {
    expect(reflow('One line\nwrapped here.\n\nSecond  paragraph.\n')).toEqual([
      { kind: 'paragraph', text: 'One line wrapped here.' },
      { kind: 'paragraph', text: 'Second paragraph.' },
    ]);
  });

  it('keeps headings and lists, with continuation lines joined to their item', () => {
    expect(reflow('# Title\n\nIntro\n\n## Part 2\nBody text\n\n- first\n  continued\n- second\n1. third')).toEqual([
      { kind: 'heading', text: 'Title' },
      { kind: 'paragraph', text: 'Intro' },
      { kind: 'heading', text: 'Part 2' },
      { kind: 'paragraph', text: 'Body text' },
      { kind: 'list', items: ['first continued', 'second', 'third'] },
    ]);
  });

  it('shows Markdown code spans as plain text', () => {
    expect(reflow('Scripts in `art/blender/` and **bold**.')).toEqual([{ kind: 'paragraph', text: 'Scripts in art/blender/ and bold.' }]);
  });

  it('loses no word of the shipped licence and notices', () => {
    for (const file of ['LICENSE', 'THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md']) {
      const source = readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
      const blocks = reflow(source);
      const shown = blocks.flatMap(b => b.kind === 'list' ? b.items : [b.text]).join(' ');
      const words = (s: string) => s.replace(/[`*]/g, '').replace(/^#+ /gm, '').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
      expect(words(shown), file).toEqual(words(source));
      for (const b of blocks) for (const text of b.kind === 'list' ? b.items : [b.text]) expect(text, file).not.toMatch(/\n|\s{2}/);
    }
  });
});

// MPES §10.2, §11: every one of the 77 subjects has its committed renders, every build layer is mapped with a
// draw order and a slot, nothing is orphaned, hashes match and the imagery fits its budget.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import sharp from 'sharp';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { RENDERS_DIR } from '../../build/render.ts';
import { VEHICLE } from '../../source/showcase/renders.ts';

interface Entry {
  readonly file: string; readonly id: string; readonly kind: string; readonly depth: number | null; readonly slot?: string;
  readonly bytes: number; readonly sha256: string;
  readonly frame: { width: number; height: number }; readonly offset: { left: number; top: number }; readonly size: { width: number; height: number };
}
const manifest = JSON.parse(readFileSync(`${RENDERS_DIR}/manifest.json`, 'utf8')) as { format: string; totalBytes: number; hidden: string[]; entries: Entry[] };
const cards = JSON.parse(readFileSync('content/cards.json', 'utf8')) as { id: string; category: string }[];
const byId = new Map(manifest.entries.map(e => [e.id, e]));
const vehicles = Object.values(VEHICLE);
const physical = cards.filter(c => c.category !== 'SE_PROCESS').map(c => c.id);
const angles = ['front', 'rear'];
const MB = 1024 * 1024;

describe('render manifest (MPES §10.2, §11)', () => {
  it('covers all 77 subjects: 70 cards, the practice card and 6 vehicles', () => {
    expect(cards).toHaveLength(70);
    for (const id of [...cards.map(c => c.id), 'TRAIN-CAP']) expect(byId.get(`card-${id}`)?.kind, id).toBe('card');
    expect(vehicles).toHaveLength(6);
    for (const v of vehicles) {
      expect(byId.get(`${v}-hero`)?.kind, v).toBe('hero');
      for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) expect(byId.get(`${v}-turntable-${String(i).padStart(2, '0')}`)?.kind, `${v} frame ${i}`).toBe('turntable');
      for (const a of angles) expect(byId.get(`${v}-${a}-base`)?.kind, `${v} ${a}`).toBe('build-base');
    }
  });

  it('has a layer for every physical card on every vehicle and angle, unless recorded as hidden there', () => {
    const hidden = new Set(manifest.hidden);
    for (const v of vehicles) for (const a of angles) for (const id of physical) {
      const key = `${v}-${a}-${id}`;
      expect(byId.has(key) !== hidden.has(key), `${key}: exactly one of layer or hidden`).toBe(true);
    }
    // A part may hide behind the hull from one angle, never from both.
    for (const v of vehicles) for (const id of physical) expect(hidden.has(`${v}-front-${id}`) && hidden.has(`${v}-rear-${id}`), `${v} ${id}`).toBe(false);
  });

  it('gives every build layer a draw order and one slot per card; SE_PROCESS cards have no layers', () => {
    const slots = new Map<string, string>();
    for (const e of manifest.entries.filter(x => x.kind === 'build-layer')) {
      expect(e.depth, e.id).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      const card = e.id.replace(/^.*-(front|rear)-/, '');
      expect(e.slot, e.id).toMatch(/^[a-z-]+$/);
      expect(slots.get(card) ?? e.slot, e.id).toBe(e.slot);
      slots.set(card, e.slot!);
    }
    expect([...slots.keys()].sort()).toEqual([...physical].sort());
  });

  it('has no orphans: every file is listed, every entry has its file and a matching hash', () => {
    const files = readdirSync(RENDERS_DIR).filter(f => f !== 'manifest.json').sort();
    expect(files).toEqual(manifest.entries.map(e => e.file).sort());
    for (const e of manifest.entries) {
      const bytes = readFileSync(`${RENDERS_DIR}/${e.file}`);
      expect(bytes.length, e.file).toBe(e.bytes);
      expect(createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex'), e.file).toBe(e.sha256);
      expect(e.offset.left + e.size.width, e.file).toBeLessThanOrEqual(e.frame.width);
      expect(e.offset.top + e.size.height, e.file).toBeLessThanOrEqual(e.frame.height);
    }
  });

  // Decoding cost grows with pixels, transparent ones included (CI run 38136462558: a purchase waited 212 ms, budget
  // 100, for layers kept near full-frame by alpha too faint to survive 8-bit output). Each build image ends within its
  // 2 px apron, plus a little for lossy edges, of its visible pixels.
  it('trims every build image to its visible pixels (MPES §10.3)', async () => {
    const SLACK = 2 + 6;
    const loose: string[] = [];
    for (const e of manifest.entries.filter(x => x.kind.startsWith('build-'))) {
      const { data, info } = await sharp(`${RENDERS_DIR}/${e.file}`).ensureAlpha().extractChannel(3).raw().toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
      let x0 = info.width, y0 = info.height, x1 = -1, y1 = -1;
      for (let y = 0; y < info.height; y++) for (let x = 0; x < info.width; x++) {
        if (!data[y * info.width + x]) continue;
        x0 = Math.min(x0, x); x1 = Math.max(x1, x); y0 = Math.min(y0, y); y1 = Math.max(y1, y);
      }
      if (x0 > SLACK || y0 > SLACK || info.width - 1 - x1 > SLACK || info.height - 1 - y1 > SLACK) {
        loose.push(`${e.file} ${info.width}x${info.height}, visible ${x1 - x0 + 1}x${y1 - y0 + 1}`);
      }
    }
    expect(loose).toEqual([]);
  }, 300_000);

  it('keeps all imagery within 40 MB (MPES §10.3)', () => {
    const total = manifest.entries.reduce((n, e) => n + e.bytes, 0);
    expect(manifest.totalBytes).toBe(total);
    expect(total).toBeLessThanOrEqual(40 * MB);
  });
});

// Unit tests that make scratch folders in .artifacts/tmp remove them afterwards: the archive and codebase tests once
// left 104 clones (29 with node_modules) behind, one set per verify (2026-10-12).
import { readdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

const DIR = resolve(import.meta.dirname);

describe('unit-test scratch', () => {
  it('every test file that makes a scratch folder removes it in afterAll', () => {
    const makers = readdirSync(DIR).filter(f => f.endsWith('.ts') && f !== 'scratch.test.ts').map(f => [f, readFileSync(join(DIR, f), 'utf8')] as const)
      .filter(([, text]) => /mkdtemp(Sync)?\(/.test(text));
    expect(makers.map(([f]) => f).sort()).toEqual(['archive.test.ts', 'codebase.test.ts', 'encode-cache.test.ts']);
    for (const [f, text] of makers) expect(text, f).toMatch(/afterAll\(\(\) => \{ for \(const dir of made\) rmSync\(dir, \{ recursive: true/);
  });
});

// MPES §10.2: stacked part layers are drawn in manifest draw order (farthest from the camera first),
// never in purchase order, so nearer parts always cover farther ones.
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { DecodedImages, stackOrder } from '../../source/showcase/showcase.ts';
import type { Render } from '../../source/showcase/renders.ts';

const layer = (depth: number, slot?: string): Render => ({
  src: 'data:image/avif;base64,', kind: 'build-layer', depth, ...(slot ? { slot } : {}),
  frame: { width: 10, height: 10 }, offset: { left: 0, top: 0 }, size: { width: 1, height: 1 },
});

describe('showcase layer order (MPES §10.2)', () => {
  const table = new Map<string, Render>([
    ['recovery-front-NEAR', layer(9.5)],
    ['recovery-front-FAR', layer(14.25)],
    ['recovery-front-MID', layer(11)],
  ]);

  it('draws the farthest part first, whatever the purchase order', () => {
    const parts = ['NEAR', 'FAR', 'MID'].map(id => ({ id, title: id }));
    expect(stackOrder(table, 'recovery', 'front', parts).map(p => p.id)).toEqual(['FAR', 'MID', 'NEAR']);
  });

  it('leaves out parts that have no layer for this vehicle and angle', () => {
    const parts = [{ id: 'NEAR', title: '' }, { id: 'NONE', title: '' }];
    expect(stackOrder(table, 'recovery', 'front', parts).map(p => p.id)).toEqual(['NEAR']);
  });

  it('draws only the most recently recorded part of each slot (MPES §10.2); the others stay in the text list', () => {
    const slotted = new Map<string, Render>([
      ['recce-front-CAP-A', layer(12, 'module')],
      ['recce-front-CAP-B', layer(11, 'module')],
      ['recce-front-COM-A', layer(10, 'antenna-left')],
    ]);
    // Purchase order: CAP-B, then COM-A, then CAP-A. CAP-A replaces CAP-B in the module slot.
    const parts = ['CAP-B', 'COM-A', 'CAP-A'].map(id => ({ id, title: id }));
    expect(stackOrder(slotted, 'recce', 'front', parts).map(p => p.id)).toEqual(['CAP-A', 'COM-A']);
  });
});

describe('decoded still images (MPES §10.3)', () => {
  const pool = (limit: number) => {
    const made: string[] = [];
    const images = new DecodedImages(limit, src => { made.push(src); return { src, isConnected: false } as unknown as HTMLImageElement; });
    return { images, made };
  };

  it('decodes each source once and returns the same image again', () => {
    const { images, made } = pool(4);
    const a = images.get('a');
    expect(images.get('a')).toBe(a);
    expect(made).toEqual(['a']);
  });

  it('drops the least recently used image beyond the limit', () => {
    const { images, made } = pool(2);
    images.get('a'); images.get('b'); images.get('a'); images.get('c');
    expect(images.size).toBe(2);
    images.get('a');
    images.get('b');
    expect(made).toEqual(['a', 'b', 'c', 'b']);
  });

  // G2 item 5: a fully built vehicle shows up to 20 layers and a base per angle, and the next view is prepared on top:
  // the other angle (up to 21), three turntable frames and the loaded card at both angles. A plain limit of 24 dropped
  // prepared images, which then decoded a second time.
  it('never drops an image prepared for the next view, however many layers a vehicle has', () => {
    const { images, made } = pool(24);
    for (let i = 0; i < 21; i++) (images.get(`shown-${i}`) as unknown as { isConnected: boolean }).isConnected = true;
    const prepared = [...Array.from({ length: 21 }, (_, i) => `other-${i}`), 'frame-0', 'frame-1', 'frame-23', 'card-front', 'card-rear'];
    const kept = images.keep(prepared);
    expect(kept.map(img => img.src)).toEqual(prepared);
    for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) images.get(`stale-${i}`);
    for (const src of prepared) expect(images.get(src), src).toBe(kept[prepared.indexOf(src)]);
    expect(made.filter(src => !src.startsWith('stale-')).length).toBe(21 + prepared.length);
    expect(new Set(made).size).toBe(made.length);
  });

  it('releases the previous prepared set when a new one is kept', () => {
    const { images, made } = pool(1);
    images.keep(['a', 'b']);
    images.keep(['c']);
    images.get('d');
    images.get('a');
    expect(made).toEqual(['a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'a']);
  });

  it('never drops an image that is on screen', () => {
    const { images } = pool(1);
    const a = images.get('a');
    (a as unknown as { isConnected: boolean }).isConnected = true;
    images.get('b');
    expect(images.get('a')).toBe(a);
  });
});

// Independent oracle: reads canonical tables straight from docs/MPES.md (Appendix A, B and §6.6),
// so tests compare the implementation with the specification text, not with itself.
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

const MPES = readFileSync(new URL('../../docs/MPES.md', import.meta.url), 'utf8');

export interface SpecCard { id: string; en: string; fr: string; startDollars: number; effects: Record<string, number> }

function rows(section: string): string[][] {
  return section.split('\n').filter(line => /^\| [A-Z]/.test(line) && !/^\| (ID|Mission ID|Round|Field|Version)/.test(line))
    .map(line => line.split('|').slice(1, -1).map(cell => cell.trim()));
}
function between(start: string, end: string): string {
  const from = MPES.indexOf(start), to = MPES.indexOf(end, from + start.length);
  if (from < 0 || to < 0) throw new Error(`MPES section not found: ${start}`);
  return MPES.slice(from, to);
}
function effects(text: string): Record<string, number> {
  const result: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const part of text.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)) {
    const match = /^([A-Z]+) ([+−-])(\d+)$/.exec(part);
    if (!match) throw new Error(`Bad effect: ${part}`);
    result[match[1]!] = (match[2] === '+' ? 1 : -1) * Number(match[3]);
  }
  return result;
}

export function specCards(): SpecCard[] {
  const appendix = between('## Appendix A', '### A.9');
  const cards: SpecCard[] = [];
  for (const row of rows(appendix)) {
    if (row[0]!.startsWith('SE-')) cards.push({ id: row[0]!, en: row[1]!, fr: row[2]!, startDollars: 200_000, effects: effects(row[3]!) });
    else cards.push({ id: row[0]!, en: row[1]!, fr: row[2]!, startDollars: Number(row[3]!.replace(/,/g, '')), effects: effects(row[4]!) });
  }
  return cards;
}

export function specMissions(): { id: string; en: string; fr: string; minimums: Record<string, number> }[] {
  const table = between('| Mission ID | EN / FR |', '### 6.7');
  return rows(table).map(row => {
    const [en, fr] = row[1]!.split(' / ');
    const minimums: Record<string, number> = { CAP: +row[2]!, MOB: +row[3]!, FP: +row[4]!, PRO: +row[5]!, COM: +row[6]!, SA: +row[7]! };
    const special = /^(REC|MC) ≥ (\d+)$/.exec(row[8] ?? '');
    if (special) minimums[special[1]!] = Number(special[2]);
    return { id: row[0]!, en: en!, fr: fr!, minimums };
  });
}

export function specDealVectors(): Record<string, string[][]> {
  const appendix = between('## Appendix B', '## Appendix C');
  const result: Record<string, string[][]> = {};
  for (const block of appendix.split('**Seed `').slice(1)) {
    const seed = block.slice(0, 32);
    result[seed] = block.split('\n').filter(line => /^\| \d \|/.test(line))
      .map(line => line.split('|').slice(2, -1).map(cell => cell.trim()));
  }
  return result;
}

### tests/unit/stage-dispose.test.ts

Paths: `tests/unit/stage-dispose.test.ts`. SHA-256 `850c666368379de7d8294d6b0eef34a0f04f825589f56c645bff6522248b6471`, 1851 bytes.

```ts
// MPES §10.3, Codex G3 review: a disposed 3D stage leaves nothing listening. A listener left on the document, the
// motion query or the canvas kept a disposed stage alive and could restart its lost-context check after disposal.
// The stage cannot be built without WebGL here, so this reads its source: every listener it adds, except on the orbit
// controls (which their own dispose removes), carries the stage's abort signal, and dispose aborts it.
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

const SOURCE = readFileSync('source/showcase/model.ts', 'utf8');

/** Each `addEventListener(` call: its receiver and its full argument text, matched to the closing parenthesis. */
function listenerCalls(source: string): { receiver: string; args: string }[] {
  const calls: { receiver: string; args: string }[] = [];
  for (const match of source.matchAll(/([\w.#]+)\.addEventListener\(/g)) {
    let depth = 1, i = match.index + match[0].length;
    for (; depth > 0 && i < source.length; i++) depth += source[i] === '(' ? 1 : source[i] === ')' ? -1 : 0;
    calls.push({ receiver: match[1]!, args: source.slice(match.index + match[0].length, i - 1) });
  }
  return calls;
}

describe('3D stage disposal (MPES §10.3)', () => {
  const calls = listenerCalls(SOURCE);

  it('finds the stage listeners', () => {
    expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(8);
  });

  it('gives every listener outside the orbit controls the stage signal', () => {
    const unsigned = calls.filter(c => c.receiver !== 'this.#controls' && !/\bsignal\b/.test(c.args)).map(c => c.receiver);
    expect(unsigned).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('aborts that signal on dispose', () => {
    const dispose = /\n {2}dispose\(\): void \{([\s\S]*?)\n {2}\}/.exec(SOURCE)?.[1] ?? '';
    expect(dispose).toMatch(/\.abort\(\)/);
  });
});
```

### tests/unit/student.test.ts

Paths: `tests/unit/student.test.ts`. SHA-256 `598b42e2329ff745753e20b31a4e4e1e69789c8efc0f4144ca75d564f18a2b80`, 6649 bytes.

// RQ-12, RQ-14: student companion commands (MPES §6.9–6.11).
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { DomainError } from '../../source/domain/errors.ts';
import * as S from '../../source/domain/student.ts';
import { validateStudent } from '../../source/domain/saves.ts';
import { specDealVectors } from './spec.ts';

const VECTOR = specDealVectors()['00000000000000000000000000000000']!;
const code = (fn: () => unknown) => { try { fn(); } catch (e) { return e instanceof DomainError ? e.code : String(e); } return 'no error'; };
const valid = (s: S.StudentState) => expect(validateStudent(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s)))).toEqual(s);

function planning(): S.StudentState {
  let s = S.join(S.studentShell('fr'), 'sea3-t4-0123456789abcdef', 3, 'TROOP');
  s = S.openPlanning(S.recordPracticeWin(s));
  return s;
}
function auction(): S.StudentState {
  return S.startAuction(S.confirmVehicle(planning(), true));
}

describe('join and practice', () => {
  it('normalizes the code and keeps only its own team', () => {
    const s = S.join(S.studentShell(), ' Sea3-T4-0123456789abcdef ', 4, 'MINE');
    expect(s).toMatchObject({ phase: 'practice', sessionCode: 'SEA3-T4-0123456789ABCDEF', teamCount: 4, teamId: 4 });
    expect(s.team!.mission).toBe('MINE');
    expect(code(() => S.join(S.studentShell(), 'SEA3-T4-0123456789ABCDEF', 5, 'MINE'))).toBe('team');
    expect(code(() => S.join(S.studentShell(), 'SEA3-4-0123', 1, 'MINE'))).toBe('code');
    valid(s);
  });
  it('requires a recorded practice win before planning and clears it after', () => {
    const s = S.join(S.studentShell(), 'SEA3-T2-0123456789ABCDEF', 1, 'COMBAT');
    expect(code(() => S.openPlanning(s))).toBe('phase');
    const won = S.recordPracticeWin(s);
    expect(S.resetPractice(won).practiceWon).toBe(false);
    expect(S.openPlanning(won)).toMatchObject({ phase: 'planning', practiceWon: false });
  });
});

describe('planning', () => {
  it('changing mission clears the confirmation and shows a notice', () => {
    let s = S.confirmVehicle(planning(), true);
    s = S.selectMission(s, 'RECCE');
    expect(s).toMatchObject({ vehicleConfirmed: false, vehicleChangeNotice: true });
    expect(code(() => S.startAuction(s))).toBe('confirmation');
    s = S.confirmVehicle(s, true);
    expect(s.vehicleChangeNotice).toBe(false);
  });
  it('bounds plan text, parses WTP in whole dollars and captures the plan baseline at auction start', () => {
    let s = S.setPlanText(planning(), 'plan', 'Treuil  + radio 📻');
    expect(code(() => S.setPlanText(s, 'risks', 'x'.repeat(1201)))).toBe('text');
    s = S.setMaxWtp(s, '900000');
    expect(s.maxWtpCents).toBe(90_000_000);
    expect(code(() => S.setMaxWtp(s, '900000.50'))).toBe('money');
    s = S.startAuction(S.confirmVehicle(s, true));
    expect(s).toMatchObject({ phase: 'auction', lockedMission: 'TROOP', planBaseline: 'Treuil  + radio 📻' });
    expect(code(() => S.setPlanText(s, 'plan', 'later'))).toBe('phase');
    valid(s);
  });
});

describe('auction tracking (RQ-12)', () => {
  it('loads only a card that fits the announced slot and records a confirmed win', () => {
    let s = auction();
    expect(code(() => S.loadCard(s, 'MOB-A'))).toBe('card');
    expect(code(() => S.recordWin(s, '400000'))).toBe('card');
    s = S.loadCard(s, ' cap-g ');
    expect(s.currentCard!.instance).toBe('R1-L1-CAP-G');
    expect(code(() => S.recordWin(s, '425000'))).toBe('money');
    s = S.recordWin(s, '450000');
    expect(s.team!.cost).toBe(45_000_000);
    expect([s.round, s.lot, s.currentCard]).toEqual([0, 1, null]);
    valid(s);
  });
  it('allows moving backward or skipping without affecting purchases, and enforces two wins per round', () => {
    let s = auction();
    s = S.setPosition(s, 3, 5);
    expect([s.round, s.lot]).toEqual([2, 4]);
    s = S.setPosition(s, 1, 2);
    expect(code(() => S.setPosition(s, 8, 1))).toBe('position');
    for (const lot of [2, 3]) s = S.recordWin(S.loadCard(S.setPosition(s, 1, lot), VECTOR[0]![lot - 1]!), '1000000');
    s = S.loadCard(S.setPosition(s, 1, 5), VECTOR[0]![4]!);
    expect(code(() => S.recordWin(s, '1000000'))).toBe('limit');
  });
  it('keeps private notes per lot and finishes after the last lot or early', () => {
    let s = S.editScratch(auction(), 'note', 'Bon rapport « qualité-prix »');
    s = S.editScratch(s, 'wtp', '410000');
    expect(s.scratch['1-1']).toEqual({ wtp: '410000', note: 'Bon rapport « qualité-prix »' });
    expect(code(() => S.editScratch(s, 'wtp', '41k'))).toBe('money');
    s = S.notOurs(S.setPosition(s, 7, 10));
    expect(s.phase).toBe('build');
    expect(S.finishAuction(auction()).phase).toBe('build');
  });
});

describe('build reconciliation and submission (RQ-12)', () => {
  function built(): S.StudentState {
    let s = auction();
    s = S.recordWin(S.loadCard(s, 'CAP-G'), '400000');
    s = S.recordWin(S.loadCard(S.setPosition(s, 2, 2), 'MOB-G'), '450000');
    return S.finishAuction(s);
  }
  it('removes mistaken entries and adds missing confirmed purchases with full validation', () => {
    let s = built();
    s = S.removeOwnPurchase(s, 'R2-L2-MOB-G');
    expect(s.team!.purchases.map(p => p.id)).toEqual(['CAP-G']);
    expect(code(() => S.removeOwnPurchase(s, 'R9-L9-NONE'))).toBe('not-found');
    expect(code(() => S.addMissingPurchase(s, 'CAP-G', 1, 1, '400000'))).toBe('duplicate');
    expect(code(() => S.addMissingPurchase(s, 'MOB-B', 1, 3, '550000'))).toBe('card');
    s = S.addMissingPurchase(s, 'mob-b', 1, 2, '600000');
    expect(s.team!.cost).toBe(100_000_000);
    valid(s);
  });
  it('converts profit between amount and percent of cost and finishes with the exact profit', () => {
    let s = S.openSubmit(built());
    expect(s.team!.cost).toBe(85_000_000);
    s = S.setProfitMode(S.setProfitInput(s, '85000'), 'PERCENT');
    expect(s).toMatchObject({ profitMode: 'PERCENT', profitInput: '10.00', profitCents: 8_500_000 });
    s = S.setProfitInput(s, '12.5');
    expect(S.draftProfit(s)).toBe(10_625_000);
    s = S.setProfitMode(s, 'AMOUNT');
    expect(s.profitInput).toBe('106250');
    s = S.finishSubmit(S.setProfitInput(s, '100000.25'));
    expect(s).toMatchObject({ phase: 'debrief', profitCents: 10_000_025 });
    s = S.closeStudent(s);
    expect(s.phase).toBe('closed');
    valid(s);
  });
  it('refuses a percent of zero cost with a non-zero profit', () => {
    const s = S.openSubmit(S.finishAuction(auction()));
    expect(code(() => S.setProfitMode(S.setProfitInput(s, '5'), 'PERCENT'))).toBe('zero-cost');
    expect(S.setProfitMode(S.setProfitInput(s, '0'), 'PERCENT').profitInput).toBe('0.00');
  });
});
